def create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    """
    Створює preview-предмет у таблиці items для попереднього перегляду покупки.
    """
    from systems import dynamic_equipment_system
    from systems.equipment_system import is_armor_slot
    from .equipment import init_weapon_damage_system, calculate_weapon_damage_by_values
    from .player import get_player_level
    from .inventory import get_bag_capacity, get_inventory_used_slots
    from .utils import format_gold
    from .character import get_character_class
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import redistribute_primary_stat_budget

    
    # Init systems
    try:
        dynamic_equipment_system.init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    except:
        pass
    
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_shop_preview_system()
    cleanup_shop_previews_for_user(user_id)

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип зброї."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип предмета для другої руки."
        }

    if slot_key in ["main_hand", "off_hand"]:
        if not is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user(user_id, slot_key, item_profile):
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Цей предмет не підходить твоєму класу."
            }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    item_level = player_level
    rarity = "common"
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(item_level, slot_key)

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    armor_type = ""

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        armor_type = get_shop_armor_type_for_user(user_id)
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = dynamic_equipment_system.generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = dynamic_equipment_system.apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    # Stage 20.6.5b: the base shop is strict class-aware, including jewelry.
    # Mob loot remains identity-aware and keeps universal random jewelry stats.
    target_class = get_character_class(user_id)
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        equipment_kind = "weapon"
    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        equipment_kind = "off_hand"
    elif slot_key in ("necklace", "ring"):
        equipment_kind = "jewelry"
    else:
        equipment_kind = "armor"
    stats = redistribute_primary_stat_budget(
        stats,
        target_class,
        equipment_kind,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        chooser=lambda profile: random.choices(
            [stat for stat, _weight in profile],
            weights=[weight for _stat, weight in profile],
            k=1,
        )[0],
    )

    sell_price = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_shop_preview_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        shop_preview_owner,
        shop_preview_price
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        user_id,
        price
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "price": price,
        "name": name,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile
    }

def get_shop_preview_weapon_damage_text(item_id):
    """Повертає ефективний бойовий діапазон шкоди для preview предмета."""
    from .equipment import init_weapon_damage_system
    from systems.equipment_system import get_effective_weapon_display_range_17_18_2_5

    init_weapon_damage_system()
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        name,
        slot_key,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        COALESCE(item_subtype, '')
    FROM items
    WHERE id=?
    """, (item_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    if not row:
        return ""

    slot_key = row[1]
    weapon_min_damage = row[2] or 0
    weapon_max_damage = row[3] or 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = row[4] or 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = row[5] or 0
    weapon_attack_type = row[6] or ""
    item_subtype = row[7] or ""

    if slot_key not in ["main_hand", "off_hand"]:
        return ""
    if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
        if weapon_min_magic_damage > 0 or weapon_max_magic_damage > 0:
            return f"✨ Магічна шкода: {weapon_min_magic_damage}-{weapon_max_magic_damage}"
    elif weapon_min_damage > 0 or weapon_max_damage > 0:
        display_min, display_max = get_effective_weapon_display_range_17_18_2_5(
            weapon_min_damage, weapon_max_damage, item_subtype
        )
        return f"⚔️ Фізична шкода: {display_min}-{display_max}"
    return ""

def use_class_reset_sphere(user_id):
    """Використовує Сферу Скидання Класу. Returns (success, message)"""
    from .inventory import count_user_item, consume_user_item_by_item_id
    from .character import set_character_class, grant_class_change_available
    
    CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID = 501
    
    init_class_reset_sphere()
    
    sphere_count = count_user_item(user_id, CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID)
    if sphere_count < 1:
        return (False, "❌ У вас немає Сфери Скидання Класу!")
    
    # Consume sphere
    consume_user_item_by_item_id(user_id, CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID, 1)
    
    # Reset class to novice
    set_character_class(user_id, "novice")
    
    # Grant class change token
    grant_class_change_available(user_id)
    
    return (True, "✅ Клас скинуто до Новачка! Ви можете обрати новий клас.")

def can_class_equip_item(character_class, item):
    """
    Перевіряє чи може клас екіпірувати предмет.
    item: dict з полями type, armor_type, weapon_attack_type
    """
    from systems.character_system import get_class_equipment_rules
    
    rules = get_class_equipment_rules(character_class)
    
    item_type = item.get("type", "")
    armor_type = item.get("armor_type", "")
    weapon_attack_type = item.get("weapon_attack_type", "")
    
    # Armor restrictions
    if item_type == "armor":
        allowed_armor = rules.get("allowed_armor_types", [])
        if armor_type and allowed_armor and armor_type not in allowed_armor:
            return False
    
    # Weapon restrictions
    if item_type == "weapon":
        allowed_weapons = rules.get("allowed_weapon_types", [])
        if weapon_attack_type and allowed_weapons and weapon_attack_type not in allowed_weapons:
            return False
    
    return True

def generate_class_shop_equipment(character_class, player_level):
    """Return canonical read-only class-shop offer descriptors.

    Compatibility API only. This function does not generate random stats, create
    item rows, or create shop previews. Actual preview creation remains owned by
    create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile).
    """
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        normalize_equipment_class,
    )

    class_key = normalize_equipment_class(character_class)
    try:
        item_level = max(1, int(player_level))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        item_level = 1

    offers = []
    armor_type = CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES[class_key]
    for slot_key in ("helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"):
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "item_profile": "",
            "armor_type": armor_type,
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "main_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "off_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    return offers

    """Compatibility adapter returning the canonical offer count without writes.

    The historical implementation inserted a full random shop into items. That
    parallel route is retired. Telegram shop previews must be created explicitly
    through create_common_equipment_shop_preview.
    """
    from .character import get_character_class

    offers = generate_class_shop_equipment(

def activate_story_quest(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    quest_number: int,
    target_quantity: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Insert one ACTIVE quest without committing the caller-owned transaction.

    Repeated activation of the same already-active quest is idempotent. Any
    different existing row or another active quest is a conflict that the
    lifecycle layer must resolve explicitly.
    """
    quest_key = str(quest_id or "").strip()
    if not quest_key:
        raise ValueError("quest_id is required")
    number = _require_positive(quest_number, "quest_number")
    target = _require_positive(target_quantity, "target_quantity")
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    existing = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_key)
    if existing is not None:
        if existing["status"] == "ACTIVE":
            return existing
        raise StoryQuestConflictError(
            f"quest {quest_key} already has persistent status {existing['status']}"
        )
    if get_active_story_quest(connection, user_id) is not None:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("user already has an ACTIVE story quest")
    try:
        connection.execute(
            """INSERT INTO user_story_quests
            (user_id, quest_id, quest_number, status, progress, target_quantity,
             reward_claimed, started_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'ACTIVE', 0, ?, 0, ?, ?)""",
            (int(user_id), quest_key, number, target, now, now),
        )
    except Exception as error:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("cannot activate story quest") from error
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_key)

def set_story_quest_progress(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    progress: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Set bounded ACTIVE progress while preserving monotonic advancement."""
    row = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if row is None or row["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    requested = max(0, int(progress))
    bounded = min(requested, int(row["target_quantity"]))
    if bounded < int(row["progress"]):
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("story quest progress cannot decrease")
    connection.execute(
        """UPDATE user_story_quests SET progress=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
        (bounded, str(timestamp or utc_now_iso()), int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)

def add_story_quest_item(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    item_key: str,
    quantity: int,
    required_quantity: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Grant a bounded quest-item quantity only to the matching ACTIVE quest.

    The operation never touches ordinary inventory and returns both the amount
    actually granted and the resulting quantity for user-visible progress.
    """
    delta = _require_positive(quantity, "quantity")
    limit = _require_positive(required_quantity, "required_quantity")
    key = str(item_key or "").strip()
    if not key:
        raise ValueError("item_key is required")
    quest = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if quest is None or quest["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    current = get_story_quest_item_quantity(connection, user_id, quest_id, key)
    resulting = min(limit, current + delta)
    granted = resulting - current
    if granted > 0:
        connection.execute(
            """INSERT INTO user_story_quest_items
            (user_id, quest_id, item_key, quantity, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id, quest_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET
                quantity=excluded.quantity,
                updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
            (int(user_id), str(quest_id), key, resulting,
             str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())),
        )
    return {"granted": granted, "quantity": resulting, "required_quantity": limit}

def reconcile_story_location_as_skipped(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quests,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Persist every unfinished quest in one exceeded location as SKIPPED.

    Existing COMPLETED rows remain authoritative. Existing SKIPPED rows are
    idempotent. ACTIVE rows and not-yet-materialized AVAILABLE/LOCKED quests are
    finalized without rewards; isolated quest-item rows for the location are
    removed by the caller-owned transaction.
    """
    ordered = sorted(tuple(quests), key=lambda quest: int(quest.number))
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    completed = skipped_now = already_skipped = 0
    quest_ids = []
    for quest in ordered:
        quest_id = str(quest.quest_id); quest_ids.append(quest_id)
        row = get_story_quest(connection, int(user_id), quest_id)
        if row is not None and str(row["status"]) == "COMPLETED":
            completed += 1
            continue
        if row is not None and str(row["status"]) == "SKIPPED":
            already_skipped += 1
            continue
        if row is not None:
            updated = connection.execute(
                """UPDATE user_story_quests
                SET status='SKIPPED', reward_claimed=0, skipped_at=?,
                    completed_at=NULL, updated_at=?
                WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
                (now, now, int(user_id), quest_id),
            )
            if updated.rowcount != 1:
                raise StoryQuestConflictError("story quest changed concurrently")
        else:
            connection.execute(
                """INSERT INTO user_story_quests
                (user_id, quest_id, quest_number, status, progress,
                 target_quantity, reward_claimed, started_at, completed_at,
                 skipped_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'SKIPPED', 0, ?, 0, ?, NULL, ?, ?)""",
                (int(user_id), quest_id, int(quest.number),
                 int(quest.target_quantity), now, now, now),
            )
        skipped_now += 1
    if quest_ids:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in quest_ids)
        connection.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id IN ({placeholders})",
            (int(user_id), *quest_ids),
        )
    return {"completed": completed, "skipped_now": skipped_now,
            "already_skipped": already_skipped, "quest_count": len(ordered)}

def skip_active_story_quest(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Mark one ACTIVE quest SKIPPED and remove only its isolated quest items.

    The caller owns commit or rollback, so status and item cleanup can remain in
    the same transaction as the future over-level lifecycle operation.
    """
    row = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if row is None or row["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    updated = connection.execute(
        """UPDATE user_story_quests
        SET status='SKIPPED', skipped_at=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
        (now, now, int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    if updated.rowcount != 1:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("ACTIVE quest changed concurrently")
    connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=?",
        (int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)

def select_event_mob_candidate(candidates: tuple, rng=None, chance_percent=None):
    import random as _random
    validated = validate_event_mob_candidates(candidates)
    if not validated:
        return None
    roller = rng or _random
    chance = max(float(row["chance_percent"]) for row in validated) if chance_percent is None else float(chance_percent)
    chance = max(0.0, min(100.0, chance))
    if float(roller.random()) >= chance / 100.0:
        return None
    total = sum(float(row["weight"]) for row in validated)
    point = float(roller.random()) * total
    cumulative = 0.0
    for row in validated:
        cumulative += float(row["weight"])
        if point < cumulative:
            return row
    return validated[-1]

def register_attribute_allocation_handlers(bot, navigation_kb_factory, character_text_factory) -> None:


    bot_key = id(bot)


    if bot_key in _REGISTERED_BOTS:


        return


    _REGISTERED_BOTS.add(bot_key)





    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "profile_attributes")


    def open_attribute_allocation(call):


        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)


        _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)





    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: str(getattr(call, "data", "")).startswith("attr:"))


    def attribute_allocation_callback(call):


        user_id = call.from_user.id


        parts = str(call.data).split(":")


        action = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""





        if action == "noop":


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)


            return


        if action == "cancel":


            _clear_draft(user_id)


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Чернетку скасовано")


            _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


            return


        if action == "back":

            _clear_draft(user_id)

            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(

                call.message.chat.id,

                character_text_factory(user_id),

                reply_markup=navigation_kb_factory(active_tab="character"),

            )

            return






        draft = _get_draft(user_id)


        if action in {"plus", "minus"} and len(parts) == 3:


            attribute = parts[2]


            if attribute not in ATTRIBUTE_ORDER:


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Невідома характеристика", show_alert=True)


                return


            pending = draft["pending"]


            if action == "plus":


                if sum(pending.values()) >= draft["expected_free_attribute_points"]:


                    bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Немає вільних очок", show_alert=True)


                    return


                pending[attribute] += 1


            elif pending[attribute] > 0:


                pending[attribute] -= 1


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)


            _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory)


            return





        if action == "confirm":


            allocation = {name: value for name, value in draft["pending"].items() if value > 0}


            if not allocation:


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Немає запланованих змін", show_alert=True)


                return


            try:


                result = allocate_attribute_points(


                    user_id,


                    allocation,


                    expected_free_attribute_points=draft["expected_free_attribute_points"],


                )


            except StaleAttributeStateError:


                _clear_draft(user_id)


                bot.answer_callback_query(


                    call.id,


                    "Баланс очок змінився. Меню оновлено.",


                    show_alert=True,


                )


                _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


                return


            except InsufficientAttributePointsError:


                _clear_draft(user_id)


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Недостатньо вільних очок", show_alert=True)


                _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


                return


            except (InvalidAllocationError, AttributeAllocationError):


                _clear_draft(user_id)


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Розподіл не застосовано", show_alert=True)


                _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


                return


            _clear_draft(user_id)


            bot.answer_callback_query(


                call.id,


                f"Розподілено очок: {result['spent']}",


                show_alert=True,


            )


            _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


            return





        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Невідома дія", show_alert=True)

def _auction_register_sell_equipment_handlers(bot):

    def auction_sell_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
            "page": 0,
        }

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_STATE)
    def auction_sell_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text != AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "item"
            state["page"] = 0
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "item":
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)

                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb()

            )
            return

        # Unknown state fallback.

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb()

def _auction_register_sell_all_handlers_v2(bot):

    def auction_sell_start_v2(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
        AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
            "page": 0,
        }

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text_v2(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2(),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2)
    def auction_sell_state_router_v2(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text not in AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_LABELS:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2(),
                )
                return

            category = AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_LABELS[text]
            _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=0)
            return

        if step == "item":
            category = state.get("category", "equipment")
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=page + 1)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=max(0, page - 1))
                return

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)
            if not inventory_id:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=page)
                return

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment

                validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
                if not validation.get("success"):
                    bot.send_message(
                        message.chat.id,
                        validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."),
                        reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0],
                    )
                    return

                snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
                state.update({
                    "step": "price",
                    "category": category,
                    "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                    "snapshot": snapshot,
                    "quantity": 1,
                })
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot),
                    reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
                )
                return

            from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction

            snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    snapshot_result.get("message", "❌ Предмет не знайдено."),
                    reply_markup=auction_stack_items_kb_v2(user_id, category, page=page)[0],
                )
                return

            snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]
            state.update({
                "step": "quantity",
                "category": category,
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_stack_quantity_prompt_v2(snapshot, category),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
            )
            return

        if step == "quantity":
            category = state.get("category")
            inventory_id = state.get("inventory_id")
            snapshot = state.get("snapshot") or {}

            try:
                quantity = int(text)
            except Exception:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Введіть кількість числом.")
                return

            from db import validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction

            validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=inventory_id,
                category=category,
                quantity=quantity,
            )
            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "❌ Некоректна кількість."))
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            state.update({
                "step": "price",
                "quantity": quantity,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2(snapshot, quantity),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
            )
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price

            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb(),
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            if state.get("category") == "equipment":
                confirm_text = build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"])
            else:
                confirm_text = build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2(
                    state["snapshot"],
                    state.get("quantity", 1),
                    price_result["price"],
                )

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, confirm_text, reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb(),
                )
                return

            category = state.get("category")

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import create_equipment_auction_lot
                result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )
            else:
                from db import create_stack_auction_lot
                result = create_stack_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    category=category,
                    quantity=state.get("quantity"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )

            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
                )
                return

            quantity_text = ""
            if int(result.get("quantity", 1) or 1) > 1:
                quantity_text = f" x{result.get('quantity')}"

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}{quantity_text}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
        )

def _auction_send_sell_category_listing_v1(bot, message, category):
    """Open one sell category through the canonical inline item-list flow."""

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()
    allowed_categories = {"equipment", "potion", "material", "rune", "consumable"}

    if category not in allowed_categories:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Невідома категорія товару.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    # A concrete category must never remain in the persistent reply keyboard.
    # The item list itself is always rendered by InlineKeyboardMarkup.
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        "📂 Категорію відкрито. Для повернення до категорій використай inline-кнопку «🔙 Категорії виставлення» під списком.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
    )

    try:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(
            user_id=user_id,
            category=category,
            page=0,
        )
    except TypeError:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, 0)
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"❌ Не вдалося відкрити категорію: {error}",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    if not isinstance(inline_kb, types.InlineKeyboardMarkup):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Список категорії має некоректний формат клавіатури.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(inline_kb)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

def auction_sell_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text != AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "item"
            state["page"] = 0
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "item":
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)

                    message.chat.id,
                    validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."),

                )

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            state["step"] = "price"
            state["inventory_id"] = inventory_id
            state["snapshot"] = snapshot
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove()
            )
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price

            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"]),
                reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            from db import create_equipment_auction_lot

            result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                price=state.get("price"),
            )

            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
                )
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        # Unknown state fallback.
        clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
        )

        if step == "category":

                if not validation.get("success"):

Тут шукачі пригод готуються до наступного полювання.\n\n👤 Твій рівень: {lvl}\n❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp}\n😴 Втома: {energy}/{max_energy}\n🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n{contracts_text}\n👀 Поблизу твого рівня можна зустріти:\n{mobs_text}\nДоступні дії:\n🔎 Полювання — вийти за межі табору\n🗺️ Мапа — переглянути напрямки та місто\n👤 Профіль — персонаж, інвентар і спорядження\n👀 Роззирнутися — оновити стан персонажа"

def build_blacksmith_repair_text(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)
    total_cost = get_total_repair_cost(user_id)
    gold = get_wallet(user_id)
    text = f'🛠️ Ремонт спорядження\n\n💰 Золото: {float(gold):.2f}\n\n📦 Стан спорядження:\n\n'
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    damaged_count = 0
    for item in equipped_items:
        slot = item['slot']
        name = item['name']
        durability = item['durability']
        repair_cost = item['repair_cost']
        is_broken = item['is_broken']
        inventory_id = item['inventory_id']
        if inventory_id is None:
            text += f'{slot}: порожньо\n\n'
            continue
        broken_text = ' ⚠️ [ЗЛАМАНО]' if is_broken else ''
        text += f'{slot}: {name}\n🛠️ Міцність: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n💰 Ремонт: {format_gold(repair_cost)}\n\n'
        if repair_cost > 0:
            damaged_count += 1
            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text=f'🛠️ Ремонт: {name} — {format_gold(repair_cost)}', callback_data=f'repair_prompt_one_v3_{inventory_id}'))
    text += f'💳 Вартість повного ремонту: {float(total_cost):.2f}\n💰 Золото: {float(gold):.2f}\n\n'
    if damaged_count <= 0:
        text += '✅ Усе спорядження вже в ідеальному стані.'
    elif gold < total_cost:
        text += '❌ Недостатньо золота для повного ремонту.\nℹ️ Можеш відремонтувати окрему річ, якщо вистачає золота.'
    else:
        text += '👇 Можна полагодити все або окрему річ.'
    if total_cost > 0:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text=f'🛠️ Полагодити все за {format_gold(total_cost)}', callback_data='repair_prompt_all_v3'))
    return (text, kb)

def build_shop_preview_display_name(name, slot_key, armor_type):
    """
    Повертає красиву назву preview-предмета.

    Для броні додає тип у дужках:
    Чоботи 5 рівня -> Чоботи [Тканина] 5 рівня

    Для зброї / off-hand тип у дужках не додається,
    бо назва вже зазвичай містить сам тип:
    Жезл 5 рівня
    Кинджал 5 рівня
    Щит 5 рівня
    """
    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        return name
    if not armor_type:
        return name
    armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)
    if not armor_label:
        return name
    if f'[{armor_label}]' in name:
        return name
    marker = ' рівня'
    if marker in name:
        index = name.rfind(marker)
        before_level = name[:index]
        after_level = name[index:]
        parts = before_level.rsplit(' ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
            return f'{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}'
    return f'{name} [{armor_label}]'

def build_sell_equipment_confirm_text(user_id, inventory_id, page=0):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    if not item:
        text = '❌ Предмет не знайдено.'
        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text='⬅️ Назад', callback_data=f'sell_eq_page:{page}'))
        return (text, kb)
    inv_id, item_id, name, type_, rarity, category, slot_key, weapon_hands, quantity, max_stack, durability, b_str, b_dex, b_int, b_wis, b_sta, pdef, mdef, sell_price = item
    quantity = quantity or 1
    sell_price = sell_price or 0
    total_price = round(quantity * sell_price, 2)
    text = f'💰 Підтвердження продажу\n\nТи точно хочеш продати цей предмет торговцю?\n\n📦 {name} ×{quantity}\n💰 Ціна: {format_gold(total_price)}\n'
    if durability is not None:
        text += f'🛠️ Міцність: {durability}/100\n'
    text += '\n⚠️ Після продажу предмет зникне з інвентаря.'
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text=f'✅ Продати за {format_gold(total_price)}', callback_data=f'sell_eq_do:{inventory_id}:{page}'))
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text='❌ Назад', callback_data=f'sell_eq_page:{page}'))
    return (text, kb)

def look_around(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.location_context_system import get_location_context_kind, get_location_context_kb
        context_kind = get_location_context_kind(user_id)
        if context_kind == 'city':
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_city_text(user_id), reply_markup=city_kb())
            return
        if context_kind == 'travel':
            # Collapsing the map does not finish travel. Keep the authoritative
            # travel/map keyboard and never expose hunting controls early.
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                '🚶 Подорож триває. Відкрий мапу, щоб переглянути статус переходу.',
                reply_markup=get_location_context_kb(user_id),
            )
            return
        if context_kind != 'location':
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                '⚠️ Не вдалося визначити поточне місцезнаходження. Відкрий мапу.',
                reply_markup=get_location_context_kb(user_id),
            )
            return
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_main_menu_text(user_id), reply_markup=main_kb())
        send_story_boss_look_around_if_present(bot, message)

def _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
    mob, player_pdef, player_mdef, player_dex, sta, level
):
    """Preserve normal/elite behavior; route bosses through Stage 15 bridge."""
    if not mob.get("is_boss"):
        result = calculate_mob_attack(
            mob_attack=mob["attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
            player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
            mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
            attack_type=mob["attack_type"]
        )
        result["boss_turn"] = None
        return result
    turn = prepare_boss_turn(mob)
    plan = turn["action_plan"]
    request = build_boss_damage_request(plan)
    if request is None:
        return {
            "damage": 0, "is_crit": False, "is_dodge": False,
            "dodge_chance": 0.0, "boss_turn": turn,
        }
    result = calculate_mob_attack(
        mob_attack=request["mob_attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
        player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
        mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
        attack_type=request["attack_type"]
    )
    result["boss_turn"] = turn
    return result

def apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, damage):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if damage <= 0:
        return damage, ""

    text = ""
    remaining_damage = damage

    for key, effect in list(mob["player_effects"].items()):
        if effect.get("type") != "shield":
            continue

        absorb_left = int(effect.get("absorb_left", 0))

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            continue

        absorbed = min(absorb_left, remaining_damage)
        remaining_damage -= absorbed
        absorb_left -= absorbed

        effect["absorb_left"] = absorb_left

        text += f"🧱 {effect.get('name', 'Щит')} поглинув {absorbed} шкоди.\n"

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            name = effect.get("name", "Щит")
            remove_player_effect(mob, key)
            text += f"💥 {name} зруйновано.\n"

        if remaining_damage <= 0:
            remaining_damage = 0
            break

    return remaining_damage, text

def build_combat_potion_kb(user_id, cooldown=0):
    items = get_inventory_detailed(user_id)
    profile_summary = get_character_profile_summary(user_id)
    uses_mana = profile_summary.get("resource_type") == "mana"

    try:
        cooldown = max(0, int(cooldown or 0))
    except Exception:
        cooldown = 0

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    found = False

    for item in items:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        is_hp_potion = type_ in ("potion_hp", "potion_hp_medium")
        is_mp_potion = type_ in ("potion_mp", "potion_mp_medium")

        if category != "potion" or not (is_hp_potion or (uses_mana and is_mp_potion)):
            continue

        found = True

        if cooldown > 0:
            button_text = (
                f"⏳ {name} ×{quantity}, "
                f"доступно через {format_combat_turns_uk(cooldown)}"
            )
        else:
            potion_cooldown = (
                5 if type_ in ("potion_hp_medium", "potion_mp_medium") else 3
            )
            button_text = (
                f"{name} ×{quantity} — "
                f"cooldown {format_combat_turns_uk(potion_cooldown)}"
            )

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=button_text,
            callback_data=f"combat_potion_{inv_id}"
        ))

    if not found:
        return None

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="⬅️ Назад до бою",
        callback_data="combat_back"
    ))

    return kb

def process_victory(bot, chat_id, user_id, lvl, mob, prefix_text=""):
    encounter_id = (mob or {}).get("pve_encounter_id")
    if encounter_id and not claim_pve_terminal(user_id, 'victory', encounter_id):
        bot.send_message(chat_id, STALE_COMBAT_TEXT, reply_markup=main_kb())
        return
    # ROM_STAGE_18_29_3F_EVENT_VICTORY_STATISTICS
    event_key = str((mob or {}).get("event_key") or "").strip()
    event_mob_key = str((mob or {}).get("event_mob_key") or "").strip()
    if encounter_id and event_key and event_mob_key:
        from db_modules.connection import conn as event_statistics_conn
        from systems.event_statistics_system import record_event_mob_victory
        record_event_mob_victory(
            event_statistics_conn,
            event_key=event_key,
            user_id=user_id,
            mob_key=event_mob_key,
            terminal_event_id=encounter_id,
        )
        event_statistics_conn.commit()
    """
    Завершення бою перемогою.

    Перед виходом із бою фіксуємо поточне HP з бойового стану
    і очищаємо тимчасові бойові ефекти.

    Це виправляє кейс, коли жрець наклав HoT у фінальному раунді,
    а залишкові тіки лікування некоректно доліковували героя після перемоги.
    """

    finalize_combat_state_before_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
        del bot.user_data[user_id]

    reward = process_victory_reward(
        user_id=user_id,
        player_level=lvl,
        mob=mob
    )

    if mob.get("is_boss"):
        encounter_id = mob.get("pve_encounter_id")
        if encounter_id:
            from systems.world_chronicle_system import (
                get_character_name_snapshot,
                record_world_chronicle_event,
            )
            character_name = get_character_name_snapshot(user_id)
            if character_name:
                record_world_chronicle_event(
                    "location_boss_defeated",
                    user_id,
                    character_name,
                    f"location_boss_defeated:{encounter_id}",
                    subject_key=str(mob.get("boss_key") or ""),
                    subject_name_snapshot=str(mob.get("name") or mob.get("base_name") or "Бос"),
                    location_id=str(mob.get("location_id") or ""),
                )

    # The RNG encounter has already passed the canonical terminal claim. A
    # matching ACTIVE BOSS quest now completes and rewards exactly once.
    story_boss_result = process_rng_boss_story_completion(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
        encounter_id=encounter_id,
    )

    wear_result = apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        chance_percent=25
    )

    contract_result = process_contract_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    daily_result = process_daily_quest_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    # Terminal victory was already claimed above, so this hook runs once per
    # encounter and cannot double-count repeated Telegram terminal updates.
    story_region_result = process_region_kill_story_progress(
        user_id=user_id,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
    )

    # Dedicated quest items are rolled after the same terminal claim and never
    # enter ordinary inventory or consume bag capacity.
    story_item_result = process_story_quest_item_drop(
        user_id=user_id,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
    )

    # Combat EXP was awarded before story progress. Evaluate the resulting level
    # only after this terminal victory's progress/drop hooks have run.
    exp_result = reward.get("exp_result") or {}
    resulting_level = int(exp_result.get("level") or get_player_level(user_id))
    story_skip_result = process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(
        user_id=user_id,
        current_level=resulting_level,
    )

    text = build_victory_text(
        user_id=user_id,
        lvl=lvl,
        mob=mob,
        reward=reward,
        wear_result=wear_result,
        contract_result=contract_result,
        daily_result=daily_result,
        prefix_text=prefix_text
    )

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        text,
        reply_markup=main_kb()
    )

    # Quest-item persistence is owned by the drop system. Telegram output is a
    # separate consumer and is emitted exactly once only for an actual grant.
    if int(story_item_result.get("granted", 0) or 0) > 0:
        story_drop_message = str(story_item_result.get("drop_message") or "").strip()
        if story_drop_message:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, story_drop_message)

    exp_result = reward.get("exp_result") or {}
    reward_message = str(exp_result.get("level_up_reward_message") or "").strip()
    level_ups = int(exp_result.get("level_ups", 0) or 0)
    if level_ups > 0 and not reward_message:
        # Some levels have no special milestone item message. Always announce
        # the canonical level transition and permanent attribute-point reward.
        old_level = int(exp_result.get("old_level", resulting_level - level_ups) or 0)
        new_level = int(exp_result.get("level", resulting_level) or resulting_level)
        points = int(exp_result.get("attribute_points_awarded", level_ups * 5) or 0)
        reward_message = (
            "🎉 Рівень підвищено!\n\n"
            f"🏆 Рівень: {old_level} → {new_level}\n"
            f"🌟 Вільні очки характеристик: +{points}"
        )
    if reward_message:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, reward_message)

    # Emit one campaign-level summary only after the level-up notification.
    # The lifecycle mutation is already committed and idempotent.
    story_skip_message = str((story_skip_result or {}).get("message") or "").strip()
    if story_skip_message:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, story_skip_message)

def register_combat_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: getattr(m, "text", None) == BOSS_CALL_BUTTON)
    def call_active_story_boss(message):
        """Start the canonical location boss only while its story quest is ACTIVE.

        Eligibility is revalidated on every press. After a successful kill,
        Stage 19.19 immediately marks the quest COMPLETED, so stale buttons and
        deliberate delayed turn-in cannot be used to farm guaranteed summons.
        Defeat or escape leaves the quest ACTIVE and permits another attempt.
        """
        user_id = int(message.from_user.id)
        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        call = get_active_story_boss_call(user_id=user_id, current_location_id=location_id)
        if not call.get("allowed"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚠️ Виклик сюжетного боса зараз недоступний.", reply_markup=main_kb())
            return
        if get_active_pve_encounter(user_id) is not None:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚔️ Спочатку заверши поточний бій.", reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb())
            return
        stats=get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"❗ Спочатку натисни /start",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        lvl=int(stats[-1]);current_hp=get_current_hp_raw(user_id);max_hp=get_max_hp(user_id)
        if max_hp<=0 or (current_hp/max_hp)*100<=25:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"😴 Здоров’я занадто низьке для виклику боса.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob=build_location_boss(location_id,lvl)
        if str(mob.get("boss_key")) != str(call.get("boss_key")):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"⚠️ Ціль сюжетного квесту не відповідає босу цієї локації.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob.update({"potion_cooldown":0,"stunned_turns":0,"skill_cooldowns":{},"enemy_effects":{},"player_effects":{},"last_skill_spent_rage":0,"last_skill_spent_combo":0,"player_hp":current_hp,"player_max_hp":max_hp,"story_boss_call":True})
        init_class_combat_resource(user_id,mob);init_combat_effects(mob)
        encounter=begin_pve_encounter(user_id,message.chat.id,mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"]=encounter["encounter_id"];mob["pve_started_at"]=encounter["started_at"];mob["pve_deadline_at"]=encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data=getattr(bot,"user_data",{});bot.user_data[user_id]=mob
        # Match the canonical hunt startup: replace the persistent location
        # keyboard with the combat placeholder before showing inline actions.
        # This prevents Hunt, Map, Profile and Look Around from remaining usable
        # while the guaranteed story-boss encounter is active.
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb(),
        )
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"👑 Голова Найманців викликає {mob['name']}!\n\n"
            "Після перемоги потрібно повернутися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю, "
            "а повторний гарантований виклик стане недоступним.",
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id,mob),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🔎 Полювання")
    def hunt(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.travel_system import is_user_travelling
        if is_user_travelling(user_id):

def call_active_story_boss(message):
        """Start the canonical location boss only while its story quest is ACTIVE.

        Eligibility is revalidated on every press. After a successful kill,
        Stage 19.19 immediately marks the quest COMPLETED, so stale buttons and
        deliberate delayed turn-in cannot be used to farm guaranteed summons.
        Defeat or escape leaves the quest ACTIVE and permits another attempt.
        """
        user_id = int(message.from_user.id)
        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        call = get_active_story_boss_call(user_id=user_id, current_location_id=location_id)
        if not call.get("allowed"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚠️ Виклик сюжетного боса зараз недоступний.", reply_markup=main_kb())
            return
        if get_active_pve_encounter(user_id) is not None:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚔️ Спочатку заверши поточний бій.", reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb())
            return
        stats=get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"❗ Спочатку натисни /start",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        lvl=int(stats[-1]);current_hp=get_current_hp_raw(user_id);max_hp=get_max_hp(user_id)
        if max_hp<=0 or (current_hp/max_hp)*100<=25:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"😴 Здоров’я занадто низьке для виклику боса.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob=build_location_boss(location_id,lvl)
        if str(mob.get("boss_key")) != str(call.get("boss_key")):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"⚠️ Ціль сюжетного квесту не відповідає босу цієї локації.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob.update({"potion_cooldown":0,"stunned_turns":0,"skill_cooldowns":{},"enemy_effects":{},"player_effects":{},"last_skill_spent_rage":0,"last_skill_spent_combo":0,"player_hp":current_hp,"player_max_hp":max_hp,"story_boss_call":True})
        init_class_combat_resource(user_id,mob);init_combat_effects(mob)
        encounter=begin_pve_encounter(user_id,message.chat.id,mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"]=encounter["encounter_id"];mob["pve_started_at"]=encounter["started_at"];mob["pve_deadline_at"]=encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data=getattr(bot,"user_data",{});bot.user_data[user_id]=mob
        # Match the canonical hunt startup: replace the persistent location
        # keyboard with the combat placeholder before showing inline actions.
        # This prevents Hunt, Map, Profile and Look Around from remaining usable
        # while the guaranteed story-boss encounter is active.
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb(),
        )
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"👑 Голова Найманців викликає {mob['name']}!\n\n"
            "Після перемоги потрібно повернутися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю, "
            "а повторний гарантований виклик стане недоступним.",
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id,mob),
        )

def attack(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку почни полювання",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(
            mob,
            attack_profile["attack_type"]
        )

        normal_attack_uses_hit_roll = attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical"

        if normal_attack_uses_hit_roll:
            player_hit_result = roll_player_normal_attack_hit(
                player_dex=dex_,
                mob_dex=mob.get("dex", 0),
            )
            player_attack_hit = bool(player_hit_result["hit"])
        else:
            player_hit_result = None
            player_attack_hit = True

        if player_attack_hit:
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=attack_profile["stat_attack"],
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=attack_profile["attack_type"],
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
        else:
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0

        mob["hp"] -= dmg

        resource_attack_text = add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = enemy_effect_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            defeat_claimed = claim_pve_terminal(user_id, "defeat")
            if not defeat_claimed:
                return

            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "⚔️ БІЙ\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        if not player_attack_hit:
            text += f"💨 ПРОМАХ! {character_name} не влучив у {mob['name']}"
        elif is_player_crit:
            text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
        else:
            text += f"🗡️ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"


        text += "\n"
        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."


        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )
