def use_skill_text_button(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Ти не в бою",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        class_skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        # Знайти навичку за ім'ям
        skill = None
        for s in class_skills:
            if s["name"] == message.text:
                skill = s
                break
        
        if not skill:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Навичку не знайдено.",
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats
        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)
        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp
        
        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
            
        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])
        skill_hit_result = roll_player_pve_skill_hit(
            skill=skill,
            player_dex=dex_,
            player_int=int_,
            mob=mob,
        )
        skill_hit = bool(skill_hit_result["hit"])
        skill_miss_text = "" if skill_hit else "💨 ПРОМАХ! Навичка «{}» не влучила в ціль.\n".format(skill["name"])
        
        if skill.get("no_damage") or not skill_hit:
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]
                
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            
            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
            
            dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0)))))
            
            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(player_pdef * 0.85)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            mob["_last_player_damage"] = int(dmg or 0)
            mob["_last_player_crit"] = bool(is_player_crit)
            
        resource_attack_text = ""
        if skill_hit and not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)
                
        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))
        if skill_hit and combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)
            
        if skill_hit:
            
            resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)
        
        stun_text = ""
        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if skill_hit:
                stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)
            
        special_effect_text = ""
        if skill_hit:
            special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
                user_id=user_id,
                mob=mob,
                skill=skill,
                damage_done=dmg
            )
        
        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                
            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "Навичка застосована.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"Ти завдав {dmg} шкоди.\n"
                
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                prefix_text += enemy_effect_text
                
            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Ворог повалений ефектами.\n"
            
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""
        
        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )
            
            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]
            
            shield_text = ""
            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )
                
            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            
            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)
            
            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:

                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
                
        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            defeat_claimed = claim_pve_terminal(user_id, "defeat")
            if not defeat_claimed:
                return

            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )
            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)
            
            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]
                
            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)
            
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)
        
        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1
            
        text = "✨ НАВИЧКА\n\n"
        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text
        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text
        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text
        if resource_attack_text:

        if cooldown_set_text:

        if special_effect_text:

        if enemy_effect_text:

        if not skill_hit:

        elif skill.get("no_damage"):

        else:
            if is_player_crit:

            else:

        text += (

            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )
        
        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)
        
        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."
            
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,

            reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
        )

functions.source:
def combat_use_skill_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "skill"):
            return
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❗ Бій вже завершено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        
        if not skill:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Навичку не знайдено.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])
        skill_hit_result = roll_player_pve_skill_hit(
            skill=skill,
            player_dex=dex_,
            player_int=int_,
            mob=mob,
        )
        skill_hit = bool(skill_hit_result["hit"])
        skill_miss_text = "" if skill_hit else "💨 ПРОМАХ! Навичка «{}» не влучила в ціль.\n".format(skill["name"])

        if skill.get("no_damage") or not skill_hit:
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]

            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )

            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)

            dmg = max(
                1,
                int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0))))
            )

            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(player_pdef * 0.85))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            mob["_last_player_damage"] = int(dmg or 0)
            mob["_last_player_crit"] = bool(is_player_crit)

        resource_attack_text = ""

        if skill_hit and not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))

        if skill_hit and combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)

        if skill_hit:

            resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)

        stun_text = ""

        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if skill_hit:
                stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)

        special_effect_text = ""
        if skill_hit:
            special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
                user_id=user_id,
                mob=mob,
                skill=skill,
                damage_done=dmg
            )

        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"

            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "Навичка застосована.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"Ти завдав {dmg} шкоди.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                prefix_text += enemy_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Ворог повалений ефектами.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            defeat_claimed = claim_pve_terminal(user_id, "defeat")
            if not defeat_claimed:
                return

            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "✨ НАВИЧКА\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if cooldown_set_text:
            text += cooldown_set_text

        if special_effect_text:
            text += special_effect_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        text += f"{skill['name']}\n"

        if skill_miss_text:

            text += skill_miss_text

        if not skill_hit:
            pass
        elif skill.get("no_damage"):
            text += "✨ Навичка застосована.\n"
        else:
            if is_player_crit:
                text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
            else:
                text += f"✨ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"


            text += "\n"

        if stun_text:
            text += stun_text

        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."


        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

def build_contracts_text(user_id):
    status = get_contract_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    level = status["level"]
    unlocked = status["unlocked"]
    completed_today = status["completed_today"]
    daily_limit = status["daily_limit"]
    active_contract = status["active_contract"]

    text = (
        f"📜 Дошка контрактів\n\n"
        f"На дошці висять замовлення від варти, торговців і мандрівників.\n"
        f"Тут можна взяти щоденне завдання на конкретну істоту.\n\n"
        f"📆 Сьогодні здано контрактів: {completed_today}/{daily_limit}\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if not unlocked:
        text += (
            f"\n🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
            f"👤 Твій рівень: {level}\n\n"
            f"Поки що варто навчитися основам: полюванню, зіллям, "
            f"екіпіруванню та ремонту спорядження."
        )

        return text, kb

    if active_contract:
        completed = active_contract.get("completed", False)

        if completed:
            text += (
                f"\n✅ Контракт виконано!\n\n"
                f"📌 Контракт готовий до здачі:\n"
                f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
                f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
                f"📈 Прогрес: "
                f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
                f"✨ Нагорода: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
                f"Повернення до Гільдії Найманців підтверджує виконання контракту."
            )

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="🎁 Здати контракт",
                callback_data="contract_claim"
            ))

            return text, kb

        text += (
            f"\n📌 Активний контракт:\n"
            f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
            f"📈 Прогрес: "
            f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
            f"✨ Нагорода після здачі: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
            f"ℹ️ Прогрес зараховується тільки за вбивство саме цієї істоти.\n"
            f"⭐ Елітна версія цієї істоти також зараховується."
        )

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="❌ Скасувати контракт",
            callback_data="contract_abandon"
        ))

        return text, kb

    if completed_today >= daily_limit:
        text += (
            f"\n✅ Ліміт контрактів на сьогодні виконано.\n"
            f"Повертайся завтра за новими завданнями."
        )

        return text, kb

    text += (
        f"\n✅ Можна взяти новий контракт.\n"
        f"ℹ️ 1 контракт = досвід за 20 мобів твого рівня.\n"
        f"🎯 Ціль буде обрана випадково серед істот, "
        f"які доступні для твого рівня та відкритих локацій."
    )

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="📜 Взяти контракт",
        callback_data="contract_take"
    ))

    return text, kb

def register_contract_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "📜 Контракти")
    def show_contracts(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "📜 Ти підійшов до дошки контрактів.",
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_take")
    def take_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        status = get_contract_status(user_id)

        if not status["exists"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                status["message"],
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        if not status["unlocked"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {status['level']}"
                ),
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        chosen_mob = choose_random_contract_mob(status["level"])

        if not chosen_mob:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Не вдалося знайти доступного моба для контракту.",
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        target_mob_name = chosen_mob.get("name", "Невідома істота")
        target_mob_level = int(chosen_mob.get("level", status["level"]))

        result = create_daily_contract(
            user_id=user_id,
            target_mob_name=target_mob_name,
            target_mob_level=target_mob_level
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_claim")
    def claim_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_contract_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        reward_message = str(result.get("level_up_reward_message") or "")
        if reward_message:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, reward_message)

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_abandon")
    def abandon_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = abandon_active_contract(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def register_dev_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /give item_id quantity
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["give"])
    def give_item(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/give item_id [quantity]\n\n"
                    "Приклад:\n"
                    "/give 201 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_id = int(parts[1])
            quantity = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 1
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ item_id і quantity мають бути числами.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося видати предмет."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"✅ DEV: предмет видано.\n\n"
            f"📦 {result.get('name', 'Предмет')} x{result.get('added', 0)}\n"
            f"🎒 Сумка: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 20)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n⚠️ Не влізло: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /setlevel N
    # /lvl N
    # /level N
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["setlevel", "lvl", "level"])
    def set_level(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/setlevel 5\n"
                    "/lvl 5\n"
                    "/level 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        target_level = parts[1]
        result = set_player_level_for_test(user_id, target_level)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /resetlevel
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["resetlevel"])
    def reset_level(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id

def give_item(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/give item_id [quantity]\n\n"
                    "Приклад:\n"
                    "/give 201 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_id = int(parts[1])
            quantity = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 1
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ item_id і quantity мають бути числами.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося видати предмет."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"✅ DEV: предмет видано.\n\n"
            f"📦 {result.get('name', 'Предмет')} x{result.get('added', 0)}\n"
            f"🎒 Сумка: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 20)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n⚠️ Не влізло: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def _edit(bot,call,text,kb):
    uid=int(call.from_user.id);state=_ACTIVE_EVENT_UI.get(uid)
    if not state or not _valid(call):return False
    try:
        bot.edit_message_text(text,int(call.message.chat.id),int(call.message.message_id),reply_markup=kb)
        return True
    except Exception:pass
    sent=bot.send_message(int(call.message.chat.id),text,reply_markup=kb)
    old_id=state.get("card_message_id")
    state["card_message_id"]=int(sent.message_id)
    _delete(bot,state.get("chat_id"),old_id)
    return True

def event_callback(call):
        if not _valid(call):bot.answer_callback_query(call.id,"Це меню вже неактивне.",show_alert=False);return
        data=str(call.data or "")[len(PREFIX):];bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        if data=="close":_close(bot,call.from_user.id,call.message.chat.id);return
        if data=="home":_edit(bot,call,_main_text(),_main_kb());return
        if data.startswith("catalog:list:"):
            try:page=int(data.rsplit(":",1)[1])
            except Exception:page=1
            text,kb=_catalog(page);_edit(bot,call,text,kb);return
        if data.startswith("catalog:view:"):
            key=data.split(":",2)[2];row=next((x for x in _event_rows() if x["event_key"]==key),None)
            if not row:_edit(bot,call,"🎉 Івент не знайдено.",_back());return
            _edit(bot,call,_main_text(),_main_kb());return
        if data.startswith("archive:list:"):
            try:page=int(data.rsplit(":",1)[1])
            except Exception:page=1
            text,kb=_archive(page);_edit(bot,call,text,kb);return

def handle_guild_creation_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_create_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text in ["❌ Скасувати створення", "🔙 Зала Гільдій", "🔙 Місто"]:
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)
        if text == "🔙 Місто":
            send_city(bot, message)
        else:
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text == "✏️ Почати заново":
        start_guild_create_state(user_id)
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_name_prompt(user_id))
        return True

    step = state.get("step")

    if step == "name":
        ok, result = validate_guild_name_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй ввести іншу назву.")
            return True
        state["name"] = result
        state["step"] = "tag"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_tag_prompt(state["name"]))
        return True

    if step == "tag":
        ok, result = validate_guild_tag_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй ввести інший TAG.")
            return True
        state["tag"] = result
        state["step"] = "icon"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_icon_prompt(state["name"], state["tag"]))
        return True

    if step == "icon":
        ok, result = validate_guild_icon_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй надіслати один emoji.")
            return True
        state["icon"] = result
        state["step"] = "confirm"
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_guild_create_confirm_text(state, user_id), reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
        return True

    if step == "confirm":
        if text != "✅ Створити гільдію":
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "Натисни ✅ Створити гільдію або скасуй створення.", reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
            return True

        result = create_guild(user_id=user_id, name=state.get("name", ""), tag=state.get("tag", ""), icon=state.get("icon", "🏰"))
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)

        if result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "✅ Гільдію створено."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        else:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити гільдію."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return True

    return False

def handle_guild_list_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_browse_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text == "⬅️ Назад":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, max(0, state.get("page", 0) - 1))
        return True

    if text == "➡️ Далі":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, state.get("page", 0) + 1)
        return True

    if text == "📜 Переглянути гільдії":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, state.get("page", 0))
        return True

    if text == "📨 Подати заявку":
        guild_id = state.get("selected_guild_id")
        if not guild_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Спочатку обери гільдію зі списку.", reply_markup=guild_list_kb(user_id, state.get("page", 0)))
            return True

        result = create_guild_application(user_id=user_id, guild_id=guild_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_detail_kb(user_id, guild_id))
        show_guild_detail(bot, message, guild_id)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    return False

def _guild_progress_handle_dev_command_v1(bot, message):
    text = (message.text or "").strip()

    if not (text.startswith("/guild_add_progress") or text.startswith("/dev_guild_progress")):
        return False

    parts = text.split()

    if len(parts) < 5:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "Формат: /guild_add_progress EXP RESOURCE KILLS CONTRACTS\n"
            "Приклад: /guild_add_progress 100 5 1 0",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
        return True

    try:
        exp = int(parts[1])
        resource = int(parts[2])
        kills = int(parts[3])
        contracts = int(parts[4])
    except Exception:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Значення мають бути цілими числами.",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
        return True

    try:
        result = add_user_guild_progress(
            user_id=message.from_user.id,
            exp=exp,
            resource=resource,
            kills=kills,
            contracts=contracts,
            reason=f"DEV progress: +{exp} EXP, +{resource} resource, +{kills} kills, +{contracts} contracts"
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result.get("message", "") + "\n\n" + build_guild_progress_text(message.from_user.id),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"❌ Не вдалося додати прогрес гільдії. Помилка: {error}",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

    return True

def format_guild_debug_text(user_id):
    try:
        diagnostics = get_guild_diagnostics(user_id)
    except Exception as error:
        return f"🧪 Guild Debug\n\n❌ Не вдалося отримати diagnostics: {error}"

    active_states = get_active_guild_ui_states(user_id)
    guild = diagnostics.get("guild")
    member = diagnostics.get("member")
    next_level = diagnostics.get("next_level_info") or {}

    text = "🧪 Guild Debug\n\n"
    text += f"User ID: {diagnostics.get('user_id')}\n"
    text += f"Season: {diagnostics.get('season_key')}\n"
    text += f"Active UI states: {', '.join(active_states) if active_states else 'none'}\n"
    text += f"User pending applications: {diagnostics.get('user_pending_applications', 0)}\n\n"

    if not guild or not member:
        text += "Guild: none\n"
        return text.strip()

    text += f"Guild ID: {guild['id']}\n"
    text += f"Guild: {get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n"
    text += f"Role: {get_guild_role_label(member['role'])}\n"
    text += f"Members: {diagnostics.get('member_count', 0)}/{guild['member_limit']}\n"
    text += f"Officers: {diagnostics.get('officer_count', 0)}\n"
    text += f"Pending applications: {diagnostics.get('pending_applications', 0)}\n\n"

    text += f"Level: {guild['level']}\n"
    if next_level:
        text += f"Прогрес рівня: {next_level.get('progress_exp', 0)}/{next_level.get('needed_exp', 0)} EXP ({next_level.get('progress_percent', 0):.1f}%)\n"

    text += "\nMonthly:\n"
    text += f"Досвід: {guild['monthly_exp']} | Ресурс: {guild['monthly_resource']} | Вбивства: {guild['monthly_kills']} | Контракти: {guild['monthly_contracts']}\n"
    text += f"Бали: {guild['monthly_score']}\n"

    text += "\nTotal:\n"
    text += f"Досвід: {guild['total_exp']} | Ресурс: {guild['total_resource']} | Вбивства: {guild['total_kills']} | Контракти: {guild['total_contracts']}\n"
    text += f"Бали: {guild['total_score']}"

    if diagnostics.get("error"):
        text += f"\n\nError: {diagnostics.get('error')}"

    return text.strip()

def _guild_global_navigation_passthrough_v2(bot, message):
    """
    Final global pass-through for common buttons that should work even if a guild state is active.
    """

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()

    if text in ["🏰 Зала Гільдій", "🔙 Зала Гільдій"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text in ["🏙️ Місто", "🔙 Місто"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        try:
            send_city(bot, message)
        except Exception:
            try:
                from handlers.city import build_city_text
                from keyboards import city_kb
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_city_text(user_id), reply_markup=city_kb())
            except Exception as error:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, f"❌ Не вдалося повернутися в місто: {error}", reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return True

    if text == "🏛 Прогрес гільдії":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_progress(bot, message)
        return True

    if text in ["📊 Внесок", "📊 Внесок за місяць"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "monthly")
        return True

    if text == "📊 Внесок за весь час":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "total")
        return True

    if text == "👥 Учасники":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "📨 Заявки":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "📜 Журнал":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, 0)
        return True

    if text == "📜 Переглянути гільдії":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_list(bot, message, 0)
        return True

    return False

def guild_add_progress_command(message):
        parts = (message.text or "").split()

        if len(parts) < 5:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Формат: /guild_add_progress EXP RESOURCE KILLS CONTRACTS\n"
                "Приклад: /guild_add_progress 100 5 1 0",
                reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
            )
            return

        try:
            exp = int(parts[1])
            resource = int(parts[2])
            kills = int(parts[3])
            contracts = int(parts[4])
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Значення мають бути цілими числами.", reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id))
            return

        result = add_user_guild_progress(
            user_id=message.from_user.id,
            exp=exp,
            resource=resource,
            kills=kills,
            contracts=contracts,
            reason=f"DEV progress: +{exp} EXP, +{resource} resource, +{kills} kills, +{contracts} contracts"
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result.get("message", "") + "\n\n" + build_guild_progress_text(message.from_user.id),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

def build_item_display_name(user_id, inventory_id, fallback_name):



    """



    Повертає назву предмета для списків інвентаря.







    Для броні додає тип у дужках:



    Чоботи 1 рівня -> Чоботи [Лати] 1 рівня







    Для зброї / off-hand НЕ додає тип у дужках,



    бо назва вже зазвичай містить сам тип:



    Кинджал 1 рівня



    Жезл 1 рівня



    Магічний талісман 1 рівня



    """







    classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)







    if not classification:



        return fallback_name







    slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")



    armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")







    # Тип у дужках показуємо тільки для броні.



    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):



        return fallback_name







    if not armor_type:



        return fallback_name







    type_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)







    if not type_label:



        return fallback_name







    # Якщо назва вже містить цей тип — не дублюємо.



    if f"[{type_label}]" in fallback_name:



        return fallback_name







    marker = " рівня"







    if marker in fallback_name:



        index = fallback_name.rfind(marker)



        before_level = fallback_name[:index]



        after_level = fallback_name[index:]







        parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)







        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():



            return f"{parts[0]} [{type_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"







    return f"{fallback_name} [{type_label}]"

def get_category_items(user_id, category_key):



    items = get_inventory_full_items(user_id)







    if category_key == "all":



        return items







    filtered = []







    for item in items:



        (



            inv_id,



            item_id,



            name,



            type_,



            rarity,



            category,



            slot_key,



            weapon_hands,



            quantity,



            max_stack,



            durability,



            b_str,



            b_dex,



            b_int,



            b_wis,



            b_sta,



            pdef,



            mdef,



            sell_price



        ) = item







        if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:



            if category == "equipment" and slot_key == category_key:



                filtered.append(item)







        elif category_key == "trash":



            if category == "trash":



                filtered.append(item)







        elif category_key == "potion":



            if category == "potion":



                filtered.append(item)







    return filtered

def build_equipped_comparison_text(user_id, slot_key, current_inventory_id):



    if not slot_key:



        return ""







    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)



    equipped_inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)







    if not equipped_inventory_id:



        return ""







    if equipped_inventory_id == current_inventory_id:



        return ""







    equipped_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(equipped_inventory_id)







    if not equipped_item:



        return ""







    (



        inv_id,



        item_id,



        name,



        type_,



        rarity,



        category,



        item_slot_key,



        weapon_hands,



        quantity,



        max_stack,



        durability,



        b_str,



        b_dex,



        b_int,



        b_wis,



        b_sta,



        pdef,



        mdef,



        sell_price



    ) = equipped_item







    display_name = build_item_display_name(



        user_id=user_id,



        inventory_id=inv_id,



        fallback_name=name



    )







    text = "\n\n⚖️ Зараз вдягнено для порівняння:\n"



    text += f"{display_name}\n"







    if item_slot_key == "main_hand":



        if weapon_hands == 2:



            text += "👐 Тип зброї: дворучна\n"



        else:



            text += "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна\n"







        weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)







        if weapon_damage_text:



            text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"







    if durability is not None:



        broken_text = " ⚠️ [ЗЛАМАНО]" if durability <= 0 else ""



        text += f"🧱 Міцність: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"







    bonuses = format_item_bonuses(



        b_str,



        b_dex,



        b_int,



        b_wis,



        b_sta,



        pdef,



        mdef



    )







    if bonuses:



        text += "📊 Бонуси:\n"







        for bonus in bonuses:



            text += f"• {bonus}\n"



    else:



        text += "📊 Бонуси: немає\n"







    return text

def build_inventory_home(user_id):



    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)



    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)



    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)







    text = (



        f"🎒 Інвентар\n\n"



        f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



        f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}\n\n"



        # ROM 17.6.1 INVENTORY MOBILE MESSAGE WIDTH



        f"Оберіть потрібний розділ вашого інвентаря:"



    )







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=2)







    row = []







    for category_key, label in INVENTORY_CATEGORIES:



        count = get_category_count(user_id, category_key)







        if category_key == "all":



            button_text = f"{label} ({used_slots})"



        else:



            button_text = f"{label} ({count})"







        row.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text=button_text,



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:0"



        ))







        if len(row) == 2:



            kb.add(*row)



            row = []







    if row:



        kb.add(*row)







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="🔙 Профіль",



        callback_data="inv_profile"



    ))







    return text, kb

def build_category_list(user_id, category_key, page=0):



    items = get_category_items(user_id, category_key)







    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)



    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)



    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)







    category_label = dict(INVENTORY_CATEGORIES).get(category_key, category_key)







    if not items:



        text = (



            f"{category_label}\n\n"



            f"У цьому розділі немає предметів.\n\n"



            f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



            f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}"



        )







        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()



        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ До розділів інвентаря",



            callback_data="inv_home"



        ))







        return text, kb







    total_items = len(items)



    total_pages = max(1, (total_items + ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // ITEMS_PER_PAGE)







    if page < 0:



        page = 0







    if page >= total_pages:



        page = total_pages - 1







    start = page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE



    end = start + ITEMS_PER_PAGE



    page_items = items[start:end]







    text = (



        f"{category_label}\n\n"



        f"🎒 Сумка: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"



        f"✅ Вільно: {free_slots}\n"



        f"📄 Сторінка: {page + 1}/{total_pages}\n\n"



    )







    if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:



        equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)



        equipped_inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(category_key)







        if equipped_inventory_id:



            equipped_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(equipped_inventory_id)







            if equipped_item:



                equipped_display_name = build_item_display_name(



                    user_id=user_id,



                    inventory_id=equipped_inventory_id,



                    fallback_name=equipped_item[2]



                )







                text += f"✅ Зараз вдягнено: {equipped_display_name}\n\n"



        else:



            text += "Слот порожній.\n\n"







    text += "Оберіть предмет для перегляду або виконання доступної дії:"







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()







    for item in page_items:



        inv_id = item[0]



        label = build_item_button_label(user_id, item)







        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text=label,



            callback_data=f"item:{inv_id}:{category_key}:{page}"



        ))







    nav_buttons = []







    if page > 0:



        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ Назад",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page - 1}"



        ))







    if page < total_pages - 1:



        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="➡️ Далі",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page + 1}"



        ))







    if nav_buttons:



        kb.add(*nav_buttons)







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="⬅️ До розділів інвентаря",



        callback_data="inv_home"



    ))







    return text, kb

def build_item_details(user_id, inventory_id, back_category="all", page=0):



    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)







    if not item:



        text = "❌ Предмет не знайдено"







        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()



        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="⬅️ Назад",



            callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"



        ))







        return text, kb







    (



        inv_id,



        item_id,



        name,



        type_,



        rarity,



        category,



        slot_key,



        weapon_hands,



        quantity,



        max_stack,



        durability,



        b_str,



        b_dex,



        b_int,



        b_wis,



        b_sta,



        pdef,



        mdef,



        sell_price



    ) = item







    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)



    required_level = get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inv_id)



    level_ok = player_level >= required_level







    equipped = is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inv_id)



    equipped_slot_key = find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inv_id)







    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()







    display_name = build_item_display_name(



        user_id=user_id,



        inventory_id=inv_id,



        fallback_name=name



    )







    text = f"📦 Предмет\n\n{display_name}\n\n"







    # ==============================



    # TRASH



    # ==============================







    if category == "trash":



        total_price = (quantity or 1) * (sell_price or 0)







        text += (



            f"🔘 Тип: сірий лут\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



            f"💰 Ціна продажу: {sell_price:.2f} золота за шт.\n"



            f"💰 Усього: {total_price:.2f} золота\n\n"



            f"ℹ️ Цей предмет можна продати торговцю в місті."



        )







    # ==============================



    # POTION / SPECIAL ITEM



    # ==============================







    elif category == "potion":



        text += (



            f"🧪 Тип: зілля / особливий предмет\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



            f"💰 Ціна продажу: {sell_price:.2f} золота за шт.\n\n"



        )







        if type_ == "potion_hp":



            text += "❤️ Ефект: відновлює 50 HP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_hp_medium":



            text += "❤️ Ефект: відновлює 120 HP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_mp":



            text += "🔵 Ефект: відновлює 40 MP\n"



        elif type_ == "potion_mp_medium":



            text += "🔵 Ефект: відновлює 100 MP\n"



        elif type_ == "class_reset" or item_id == CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID:



            text += (



                "🔮 Ефект: дозволяє змінити клас персонажа.\n"



                "Після використання відкриється вибір нового класу.\n"



            )



        else:



            text += "ℹ️ Ефект предмета поки не описаний.\n"







        text += "\nℹ️ Предмет використовується з інвентаря."







        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



            text="🧪 Використати",



            callback_data=f"usepot:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



        ))







    # ==============================



    # EQUIPMENT



    # ==============================







    elif category == "equipment":



        slot_label = get_slot_label(slot_key)







        text += (



            f"🧰 Тип: спорядження\n"



            f"🎯 Слот: {slot_label}\n"



        )







        allowed_classes_text = build_item_allowed_classes_text(



            user_id=user_id,



            inventory_id=inv_id



        )







        if allowed_classes_text:



            text += allowed_classes_text







        level_text = "✅" if level_ok else "🔒"







        text += (



            f"🏷 Рівень предмета: {required_level} {level_text}\n"



            f"👤 Твій рівень: {player_level}\n"



        )







        if not level_ok:



            text += f"⚠️ Цей предмет можна буде вдягнути з {required_level} рівня.\n"







        if slot_key == "main_hand":



            if weapon_hands == 2:



                text += "👐 Тип зброї: дворучна\n"



                text += "⚠️ Дворучна зброя блокує другу руку.\n"



            else:



                text += "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна\n"







            weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)







            if weapon_damage_text:



                text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"







        if durability is not None:



            broken_text = " ⚠️ [ЗЛАМАНО]" if durability <= 0 else ""



            text += f"🧱 Міцність: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"







        bonuses = format_item_bonuses(



            b_str,



            b_dex,



            b_int,



            b_wis,



            b_sta,



            pdef,



            mdef



        )







        if bonuses:



            text += "\n📊 Бонуси:\n"







            for bonus in bonuses:



                text += f"• {bonus}\n"



        else:



            text += "\n📊 Бонуси: немає\n"







        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:



            text += "\n⚠️ Предмет зламаний і не дає бонусів до ремонту.\n"







        comparison_text = build_equipped_comparison_text(



            user_id=user_id,



            slot_key=slot_key,



            current_inventory_id=inv_id



        )







        if comparison_text:



            text += comparison_text







        if equipped:



            equipped_slot_label = get_slot_label(equipped_slot_key)



            text += f"\n✅ Зараз вдягнено у слот: {equipped_slot_label}"







            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



                text="❌ Зняти",



                callback_data=f"unequip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



            ))



        else:



            if level_ok:



                kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



                    text=f"✅ Вдягнути у слот: {slot_label}",



                    callback_data=f"equip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"



                ))



            else:



                text += "\n🔒 Кнопка вдягання недоступна через недостатній рівень.\n"







    # ==============================



    # OTHER



    # ==============================







    else:



        text += (



            f"📦 Категорія: {category}\n"



            f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"



        )







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="⬅️ Назад до розділу",



        callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"



    ))







    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(



        text="🏠 До розділів інвентаря",



        callback_data="inv_home"



    ))







    return text, kb

def register_inventory_handlers(bot):







    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🎒 Інвентар")



    def show_inventory(message):



        user_id = message.from_user.id







        text, kb = build_inventory_home(user_id)







        bot.send_message(



            message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb if kb else profile_kb()



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "inv_home")



    def inventory_home_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        text, kb = build_inventory_home(user_id)







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb if kb else profile_kb()



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "inv_profile")



    def inventory_profile_callback(call):



        from handlers.profile import build_character_text, profile_inline_kb







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)



        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            "👤 Розділ персонажа відкрито",



            reply_markup=profile_kb()



        )



        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            build_character_text(call.from_user.id),



            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="character")



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("invcat:"))



    def inventory_category_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        category_key = parts[1]



        page = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0







        text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, category_key, page)







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("item:"))



    def item_details_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])



        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"



        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0







        text, kb = build_item_details(



            user_id=user_id,



            inventory_id=inventory_id,



            back_category=back_category,



            page=page



        )







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("equip:"))



    def equip_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])



        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"



        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0







        result = equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id)







        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            result



        )







        text, kb = build_item_details(



            user_id=user_id,



            inventory_id=inventory_id,



            back_category=back_category,



            page=page



        )







        bot.send_message(



            call.message.chat.id,



            text,



            reply_markup=kb



        )







    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("unequip:"))



    def unequip_callback(call):



        user_id = call.from_user.id







        parts = call.data.split(":")



        inventory_id = int(parts[1])

def _rebirth_preview_text_18_16_10(user_id, final=False):


    from systems.attribute_respec_system import get_attribute_respec_preview


    p = get_attribute_respec_preview(int(user_id))


    a = p["allocated"]


    title = "⚠️ Остаточне підтвердження" if final else "♻️ Скидання характеристик"


    lines = [title, "", "Буде повернено:", "",


        f"• Сила: {a['strength']}", f"• Спритність: {a['dexterity']}",


        f"• Інтелект: {a['intelligence']}", f"• Мудрість: {a['wisdom']}",


        f"• Витривалість: {a['stamina']}", "",


        f"⭐ Усього повернеться: {p['returned_points']} очок",


        f"📌 Вільних очок після скидання: {p['free_after']}", "",


        "Клас персонажа не зміниться."]


    if final:


        lines.extend(["Цю дію не можна скасувати після виконання.", "Сфера Переродження буде витрачена."])


    else:


        lines.append("Сфера Переродження буде витрачена лише після підтвердження.")


    return "\n".join(lines), p

def register_inventory_handlers(bot):


    _SPHERE_BASE_REGISTER_INVENTORY_HANDLERS_18_16_10(bot)





    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: str(call.data or "").startswith("rebirth:"))


    def rebirth_sphere_callbacks_18_16_10(call):


        parts = str(call.data or "").split(":")


        if len(parts) < 5:


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Некоректна дія.", show_alert=True); return


        action, inventory_id, category, page = parts[1], int(parts[2]), parts[3], int(parts[4])


        user_id = int(call.from_user.id)


        row = _sphere_inventory_item_18_16_10(user_id, inventory_id)


        if not row or int(row[1]) != _REBIRTH_SPHERE_ITEM_ID_18_16_10:


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Сфера Переродження більше недоступна.", show_alert=True); return


        try:


            text, preview = _rebirth_preview_text_18_16_10(user_id, final=(action == "final"))


        except Exception as error:


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, str(error), show_alert=True); return


        if preview["returned_points"] <= 0:


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Немає розподілених очок. Сфера не витрачена.", show_alert=True); return


        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)


        if action == "preview":


            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Продовжити", callback_data=f"rebirth:final:{inventory_id}:{category}:{page}"))


        elif action == "final":


            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("♻️ Підтвердити скидання", callback_data=f"rebirth:confirm:{inventory_id}:{category}:{page}"))


        elif action == "confirm":


            from systems.attribute_respec_system import reset_allocated_attributes, RespecAlreadyProcessed, AttributeRespecError


            from systems.player_system import get_max_hp


            from systems.character_system import get_max_mp


            key = f"telegram:rebirth:{user_id}:{inventory_id}:{call.message.chat.id}:{call.message.message_id}"


            try:


                result = reset_allocated_attributes(user_id, inventory_id, key,


                    operation_type="attribute_respec", expected_item_id=504,


                    max_hp_getter=get_max_hp, max_mp_getter=get_max_mp)


            except RespecAlreadyProcessed:


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Це підтвердження вже оброблено.", show_alert=True); return


            except AttributeRespecError as error:


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, str(error), show_alert=True); return


            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)


            bot.edit_message_text(


                "✅ Характеристики скинуто\n\n"


                f"⭐ Повернено очок: {result['before']['returned_points']}\n"


                f"📌 Вільних очок: {result['after']['free_before']}\n\n"


                "Повторно розподілити очки можна у профілі: «Характеристики».",


                call.message.chat.id, call.message.message_id)


            return


        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Скасувати", callback_data=f"item:{inventory_id}:{category}:{page}"))


        bot.edit_message_text(text, call.message.chat.id, call.message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)


        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

def build_item_details(user_id, inventory_id, back_category="all", page=0):

    item_row = cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(max_stack,1) FROM items WHERE id=?", (item_id,)

    from systems.attribute_respec_system import get_attribute_respec_preview

    else:

            "♻️ Сфера Переродження\n\n"
            "🧰 Категорія: Витратні предмети\n"
            f"📦 У цьому стакі: ×{quantity}/{max_stack}\n"
            "🔄 Одноразовий предмет\n\n"
            "Сфера накопичує силу переродження та дозволяє повністю скинути "

            f"⭐ Зараз можна повернути: {preview['returned_points']} очок\n"

        )
    return (text, keyboard, *result[2:])

def map_callbacks(call):
        data=str(call.data);parts=data.split(':');action=parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ''
        uid=int(call.from_user.id);chat=call.message.chat.id;mid=call.message.message_id
        if action=='open': _safe_answer(bot,call);render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
        if action=='refresh':
            try: travel_id=int(parts[2]);revision=int(parts[3])
            except Exception: _safe_answer(bot,call,"Некоректна дія.",True);return
            active=get_active_travel(uid)
            if not active or travel_id != int(active["id"]) or revision != int(active["revision"]):
                old=get_travel(travel_id)
                _safe_answer(bot,call,"Подорож уже завершена або скасована.",True)
                render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
            _safe_answer(bot,call);render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
        if action=='players':
            _safe_answer(bot,call)
            if get_active_travel(uid): _safe_answer(bot,call,"Під час подорожі список недоступний.",True);return
            from systems.player_interaction_system import get_online_players_in_same_location,touch_player_activity
            from handlers.player_interaction import build_location_players_text,build_location_players_kb
            touch_player_activity(uid);result=get_online_players_in_same_location(uid,page=0,page_size=8)
            bot.edit_message_text(build_location_players_text(result),chat_id=chat,message_id=mid,parse_mode='HTML',reply_markup=build_location_players_kb(result));return
        if action=='locked':
            target=parts[2] if len(parts)>2 else '';loc=LOCATIONS.get(target) or {};_safe_answer(bot,call,f"Потрібний рівень: {loc.get('unlock_level','?')}",True);return
        if action=='preview':
            _safe_answer(bot,call);target=parts[2] if len(parts)>2 else ''
            # Authoritative validation occurs again in start_travel.
            if target not in get_adjacent_nodes(get_current_location(uid) or CITY_NODE): render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
            bot.edit_message_text(build_travel_preview_text(uid,target),chat_id=chat,message_id=mid,reply_markup=build_travel_preview_kb(target));return
        if action=='start':
            target=parts[2] if len(parts)>2 else '';result=start_travel(uid,target,busy_checker=lambda user_id:_travel_start_busy(bot,user_id))
            if not result.get('success'): _safe_answer(bot,call,_failure_message(result.get('reason')),True);render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
            _safe_answer(bot,call,"Подорож розпочато");render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
        if action=='cancel':
            try: travel_id=int(parts[2]);revision=int(parts[3])
            except Exception: _safe_answer(bot,call,"Некоректна дія.",True);return
            result=cancel_travel(uid,travel_id,expected_revision=revision)
            _safe_answer(bot,call,"Подорож скасовано." if result.get('success') else "Подорож уже завершена.",not result.get('success'))
            render_map_message(bot,chat,uid,mid);return
        _safe_answer(bot,call,"Дія неактуальна.",True)
