    if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "⚠️ Лот уже недоступний.",
        }

    snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])

    category = lot["category"]
    quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
    refine_level = int(lot["enhancement_level"] or snapshot.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    item_type = snapshot.get("item_type") or _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "type", "item_type", default="")
    slot_key = snapshot.get("slot_key") or _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "slot_key", "slot", default="")
    rarity = lot["rarity"] or snapshot.get("rarity") or _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "rarity", default="")
    level = int(lot["level"] or snapshot.get("level", 0) or 0)

    lines = []
    lines.append("📦 Лот Торгового Дому")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(str(lot["item_name"]))
    lines.append("")

    lines.append(f"📂 Категорія: {_auction_category_ua(category)}")

    if category == AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT:
        lines.append(f"🎒 Слот/тип: {_auction_slot_ua(slot_key, item_type)}")
        if rarity:
            lines.append(f"⭐ Рідкість: {_auction_rarity_ua(rarity)}")
        if level:
            lines.append(f"🏷 Рівень: {level}")
        if refine_level:
            lines.append(f"✨ Заточка: +{refine_level}")
        if lot["durability_current"] is not None:
            lines.append(f"🔧 Міцність: {lot['durability_current']}/{lot['durability_max']}")

        damage_lines = _auction_damage_lines_from_weapon_damage_dict(snapshot.get("auction_weapon_damage"))
        if not damage_lines:
            damage_lines = _auction_collect_damage_lines(snapshot)

        stat_lines = _auction_collect_equipment_stat_lines(snapshot)

        if damage_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("— Шкода —")
            lines.extend(damage_lines)

        if stat_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("— Бонуси предмета —")
            lines.extend(stat_lines)

        if not damage_lines and not stat_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("ℹ️ Детальні стати для цього предмета не знайдені у snapshot лота.")
            lines.append("Нові лоти, виставлені після 8.0.5c, зберігатимуть більше бойових даних.")

    else:
        lines.append(f"📦 Кількість: {quantity}")
        desc_lines = _auction_collect_stack_description_lines(snapshot)
        if desc_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.extend(desc_lines)

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"💰 Ціна: {lot['price']} золота")
    lines.append("⏳ Активний лот: до 7 днів від створення")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Продавець прихований.")

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lot": lot,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
        "text": "\n".join(lines),
    }

def _auction_collect_inventory_style_bonus_lines(snapshot):
    stat_groups = [
        ("bonus_str", "str", "strength"),
        ("bonus_dex", "dex", "dexterity"),
        ("bonus_int", "int", "intelligence"),
        ("bonus_wis", "wis", "wisdom"),
        ("bonus_sta", "sta", "stamina"),
    ]

    lines = []

        key, value = _auction_ua_stat_value(snapshot, *group)

        icon, label = _auction_ua_stat_label(key)
        sign = "+" if value > 0 else ""

    return lines

def _auction_weapon_hand_line(snapshot):
    name = str(snapshot.get("name") or snapshot.get("raw_name") or "").lower()
    item_type = str(snapshot.get("item_type") or "").lower()

    two_handed_raw = _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "two_handed", "is_two_handed", "requires_two_hands", "twohanded")
    hands_raw = _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "hands", "weapon_hands", "handedness")

    two_handed = False
    if str(two_handed_raw).lower() in ["1", "true", "yes", "так"]:
        two_handed = True
    if str(hands_raw).lower() in ["2", "two", "two_handed", "2h", "дворучна", "дворучний"]:
        two_handed = True
    if "дворуч" in name:
        two_handed = True

    is_weapon = bool(
        snapshot.get("auction_weapon_damage")
        or item_type in ["weapon", "staff", "wand", "sword", "axe", "mace", "dagger", "bow"]
        or "жезл" in name
        or "посох" in name
        or "меч" in name
        or "сокир" in name
        or "киндж" in name
        or "лук" in name
    )

    if not is_weapon:
        return None

    return "✋ Тип зброї: дворучна" if two_handed else "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна"

def build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=None):

    category = lot["category"]

def build_auction_sell_item_review_text(user_id, inventory_id, category):
    """
    Builds an inventory-style preview before listing an item.

    This is for seller-side review only. It deliberately does not show player-specific
    equip warnings such as current player level or "can equip from level" messages.
    """

    category = normalize_auction_category(category)

    if category == AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT:
        validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not validation.get("success"):
            return validation

        snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
        try:
            snapshot = _auction_enrich_equipment_snapshot_with_runtime_details(user_id, inventory_id, snapshot)
        except Exception:
            pass

        refine_level = int(snapshot.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
        item_type = snapshot.get("item_type") or _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "type", "item_type", default="")
        slot_key = snapshot.get("slot_key") or _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "slot_key", "slot", default="")
        level = int(snapshot.get("level", 0) or 0)

        lines = []
        lines.append("📦 Огляд товару")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(str(snapshot.get("name") or "Предмет"))
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(_auction_inventory_style_type_line(AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT))
        lines.append(f"🎯 Слот: {_auction_inventory_style_slot(snapshot, slot_key, item_type)}")
        type_line = _auction_equipment_type_line(snapshot)
        if type_line:
            lines.append(type_line)

        class_line = _auction_allowed_classes_line(snapshot)
        if class_line:
            lines.append(class_line)

        if level:
            lines.append(f"🏷 Рівень предмета: {level} 🔒")

        weapon_hand_line = _auction_weapon_hand_line(snapshot)
        if weapon_hand_line:
            lines.append(weapon_hand_line)

        damage_lines = _auction_inventory_style_damage_lines(snapshot)
        lines.extend(damage_lines)

        defense_lines = _auction_collect_inventory_style_defense_lines(snapshot)
        lines.extend(defense_lines)

        durability_current = snapshot.get("durability_current")
        durability_max = snapshot.get("durability_max")
        if durability_current is not None:
            lines.append(f"🧱 Міцність: {durability_current}/{durability_max}")

        bonus_lines = _auction_collect_inventory_style_bonus_lines(snapshot)
        if bonus_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("📊 Бонуси:")
            lines.extend(bonus_lines)

        if refine_level:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(f"✨ Заточка: +{refine_level}")

        if not damage_lines and not defense_lines and not bonus_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("ℹ️ Детальні характеристики для цього предмета не знайдені у snapshot.")

        rune_lines = _auction_rune_socket_lines(snapshot)
        if rune_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.extend(rune_lines)

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Перевір характеристики предмета перед тим, як ввести ціну.")

        return {
            "success": True,
            "snapshot": snapshot,
            "text": "\n".join(lines),
        }

    # Stack items: potions/materials.
    snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
    if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
        return snapshot_result

    snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]

    if _auction_is_success_rune(snapshot):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ 💎 Руну Успіху не можна виставити на Торговий Дім.",
        }

    if not _auction_stack_category_matches(snapshot, category):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Предмет не належить до обраної категорії.",
        }

    quantity = int(snapshot.get("quantity", 0) or 0)

    lines = []
    lines.append("📦 Огляд товару")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(str(snapshot.get("name") or "Предмет"))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(_auction_inventory_style_type_line(category))
    lines.append(f"📦 У наявності: {quantity}")

    desc_lines = _auction_collect_stack_description_lines(snapshot)
    if desc_lines:
        lines.append("")
        lines.extend(desc_lines)

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Перевір товар перед тим, як вказати кількість для продажу.")

    return {
        "success": True,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
        "text": "\n".join(lines),
    }

def cancel_active_auction_lot(user_id, lot_id):
    """
    Cancels seller's ACTIVE lot and returns item to inventory.

    Status: ACTIVE -> EXPIRED_CLAIMED.
    This mirrors manual cancel in the spec: the seller receives the item back immediately.
    """
    init_auction_house()
    user_id = int(user_id)
    lot_id = int(lot_id)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=? AND seller_user_id=?", (lot_id, user_id))
        lot = cursor.fetchone()

        if not lot:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено."}

        if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Зняти можна тільки активний лот."}

        snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)

        # Return item first; this checks/uses inventory space.
        returned_inventory_id = _auction_insert_inventory_from_snapshot(user_id, snapshot, quantity=quantity)

        now = now_iso()
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            claimed_at=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND seller_user_id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED,
            now,
            now,
            lot_id,
            user_id,
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже недоступний."}

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_CANCELLED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            lot["item_name"],
            lot["category"],
            quantity,
            lot["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED,
            safe_json_dumps({"returned_inventory_id": returned_inventory_id}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": "✅ Лот знято з продажу.",
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": lot["item_name"],
            "quantity": quantity,
            "inventory_id": returned_inventory_id,
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Помилка зняття лота: {error}"}

def get_auction_lots_for_buy_filtered(buyer_user_id, category="all", sort_key="new", limit=8, offset=0):
    """
    Returns ACTIVE lots for buyer with category filter and sorting.

    Own lots are hidden from buyer.
    """
    init_auction_house()
    update_expired_auction_lots()

    buyer_user_id = int(buyer_user_id)
    category = _auction_buy_normalize_category(category)
    sort_key = _auction_buy_normalize_sort(sort_key)

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 8
    try:
        offset = int(offset)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    limit = max(1, min(50, limit))
    offset = max(0, offset)

    where = ["status=?", "seller_user_id<>?"]
    params = [AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE, buyer_user_id]

    if category != AUCTION_BUY_CATEGORY_ALL:
        where.append("category=?")
        params.append(category)

    order_by = "created_at DESC"
    if sort_key == "old":
        order_by = "created_at ASC"
    elif sort_key == "price_asc":
        order_by = "CAST(price AS REAL) ASC, created_at DESC"
    elif sort_key == "price_desc":
        order_by = "CAST(price AS REAL) DESC, created_at DESC"
    elif sort_key == "rarity":
        order_by = """
        CASE rarity
            WHEN 'epic' THEN 4
            WHEN 'rare' THEN 3
            WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
            WHEN 'common' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END DESC,
        level DESC,
        created_at DESC
        """

    sql = f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE {' AND '.join(where)}
    ORDER BY {order_by}
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    """
    params.extend([limit, offset])

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchall()

def buy_auction_lot_v2(buyer_user_id, lot_id):
    """
    Transactional auction purchase.

    ACTIVE -> SOLD_UNCLAIMED.
    Buyer receives item immediately.
    Seller claims gold later in completed sales.
    """
    init_auction_house()
    update_expired_auction_lots()

    buyer_user_id = int(buyer_user_id)
    lot_id = int(lot_id)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?", (lot_id,))
        lot = cursor.fetchone()

        if not lot:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено."}

        if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже недоступний."}

        seller_user_id = int(lot["seller_user_id"] or 0)
        if seller_user_id == buyer_user_id:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Не можна купити власний лот."}

        price = auction_price_to_decimal(lot["price"])
        buyer_gold = _auction_get_user_gold(buyer_user_id)

        if buyer_gold < price:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    "❌ Недостатньо золота.\n\n"
                    f"💰 Потрібно: {decimal_to_price_text(price)}\n"
                    f"💰 У тебе: {decimal_to_price_text(buyer_gold)}"
                )
            }

        snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)

        inventory_id = _auction_insert_inventory_from_snapshot(
            buyer_user_id,
            snapshot,
            quantity=quantity,
        )

        _auction_set_user_gold(buyer_user_id, buyer_gold - price)

        now = now_iso()
        delete_after = _auction_plus_days_iso_v2(now, AUCTION_UNCLAIMED_RETENTION_DAYS_V2)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            buyer_user_id=?,
            sold_at=?,
            delete_after=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
            buyer_user_id,
            now,
            delete_after,
            now,
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже куплений іншим гравцем."}

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_SOLD,
            buyer_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            lot["item_name"],
            lot["category"],
            quantity,
            lot["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
            safe_json_dumps({"buyer_inventory_id": inventory_id}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": "✅ Покупку завершено!",
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": lot["item_name"],
            "quantity": quantity,
            "price": lot["price"],
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Помилка покупки: {error}"}

def get_auction_lots_for_buy_search(buyer_user_id, search_text, sort_key="new", limit=8, offset=0):
    """
    Search ACTIVE lots by public item name.

    - Own lots are hidden.
    - Search uses item_name_norm when available.
    - All words in the query must be present in the item name.
    """

    init_auction_house()
    update_expired_auction_lots()

    except Exception:
        limit = 8
    try:
        offset = int(offset)

        offset = 0

    limit = max(1, min(50, limit))
    offset = max(0, offset)

    where = ["status=?", "seller_user_id<>?"]
    params = [AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE, buyer_user_id]

    tokens = [token for token in query.split(" ") if token]
    for token in tokens:
        where.append("(item_name_norm LIKE ? OR LOWER(item_name) LIKE ?)")
        params.append(f"%{token}%")
        params.append(f"%{token}%")

    order_by = "created_at DESC"
    if sort_key == "old":

    elif sort_key == "price_desc":

            WHEN 'uncommon' THEN 2
            WHEN 'common' THEN 1

        END DESC,
        level DESC,

def _auction_inventory_style_weapon_type_line(snapshot):
    """
    Формує рядок типу зброї для картки лота Торгового Дому.

    Важливо:
    попередній compatibility-alias міг помилково передавати весь snapshot
    у generic type formatter, через що в картці лота з'являвся рядок типу:

    🧰 Тип: {'durability_current': 100, ...}

    Правильна поведінка:
    - для зброї показати:
      ✋ Тип зброї: одноручна / дворучна
    - для броні, біжутерії, матеріалів, зілля — не показувати нічого.
    """

    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
        return ""

    item_type = str(
        snapshot.get("item_type")
        or snapshot.get("type")
        or snapshot.get("item_category")
        or ""
    )

    slot_key = str(
        snapshot.get("slot_key")
        or snapshot.get("item_slot")
        or snapshot.get("item_slot_key")
        or ""
    )

    row = snapshot.get("row") or {}

    if isinstance(row, dict):
        item_type = item_type or str(row.get("item_type") or "")
        slot_key = slot_key or str(row.get("item_slot_key") or "")

    weapon_min_damage = int(snapshot.get("weapon_min_damage", 0) or 0)
    weapon_max_damage = int(snapshot.get("weapon_max_damage", 0) or 0)
    weapon_min_magic_damage = int(snapshot.get("weapon_min_magic_damage", 0) or 0)
    weapon_max_magic_damage = int(snapshot.get("weapon_max_magic_damage", 0) or 0)

    if isinstance(row, dict):
        weapon_min_damage = weapon_min_damage or int(row.get("item_weapon_min_damage", 0) or 0)
        weapon_max_damage = weapon_max_damage or int(row.get("item_weapon_max_damage", 0) or 0)
        weapon_min_magic_damage = weapon_min_magic_damage or int(row.get("item_weapon_min_magic_damage", 0) or 0)
        weapon_max_magic_damage = weapon_max_magic_damage or int(row.get("item_weapon_max_magic_damage", 0) or 0)

    is_weapon = (
        item_type == "weapon"
        or slot_key == "main_hand"
        or weapon_min_damage > 0
        or weapon_max_damage > 0
        or weapon_min_magic_damage > 0
        or weapon_max_magic_damage > 0
    )

    if not is_weapon:
        return ""

    weapon_hands = snapshot.get("weapon_hands")

    if weapon_hands is None and isinstance(row, dict):
        weapon_hands = row.get("item_weapon_hands")

    try:
        weapon_hands = int(weapon_hands or 1)
    except Exception:
        weapon_hands = 1

    if weapon_hands >= 2:
        weapon_type_label = "дворучна"
    else:
        weapon_type_label = "одноручна"

    return f"✋ Тип зброї: {weapon_type_label}"

def scale_boss_stat_ranges(definition: Mapping[str, Any], player_level: int) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Build dynamic boss primary ranges and Rule A HP/Attack ceilings."""
    import math

    level_min = _int(definition["level_min"], 1)
    level_max = _int(definition["level_max"], level_min)
    level = max(level_min, min(level_max, _int(player_level, level_min)))
    templates = _templates_for_level(str(definition["location_id"]), level)
    if not templates:
        raise ValueError(f"No normal mob templates for boss reference: {definition['location_id']} level {level}")

    boss_primary_multiplier = BOSS_PRIMARY_STAT_MULTIPLIER
    boss_hp_multiplier = BOSS_HP_OUTPUT_MULTIPLIER
    elite_hp_multiplier = BOSS_ELITE_HP_CEILING_MULTIPLIER
    elite_attack_multiplier = BOSS_ELITE_ATTACK_CEILING_MULTIPLIER
    scaled = {}
    for prefix in ("dex", "str", "int", "wis", "sta"):
        lo, hi = _average_range(templates, f"{prefix}_min", f"{prefix}_max")
        scaled[f"{prefix}_min"] = max(1, round(lo * boss_primary_multiplier))
        scaled[f"{prefix}_max"] = max(scaled[f"{prefix}_min"], round(hi * boss_primary_multiplier))

    elite_hp_ceiling = 0
    elite_attack_ceiling = 0
    for template in templates:
        normal_hp = max(1, math.ceil(level * 10 + _int(template.get("sta_max"), 1) * 5))
        attack_type = template.get("attack_type", "physical")
        if attack_type == "physical":
            normal_attack = max(1, math.ceil(level * 2 + _int(template.get("str_max"), 1)))
        else:
            normal_attack = max(1, math.ceil(
                level * 2 + _int(template.get("int_max"), 1)
                + _int(template.get("wis_max"), 1) * 0.25
            ))
        elite_hp_ceiling = max(elite_hp_ceiling, int(normal_hp * elite_hp_multiplier))
        elite_attack_ceiling = max(elite_attack_ceiling, int(normal_attack * elite_attack_multiplier))

    scaled["boss_hp_multiplier"] = boss_hp_multiplier
    scaled["elite_hp_ceiling"] = elite_hp_ceiling
    scaled["elite_attack_ceiling"] = elite_attack_ceiling
    return scaled

def build_location_boss(location_id: str, player_level: int, rng=None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build a dynamic boss snapshot with Rule A HP and Attack guarantees."""
    import math

    definition = get_location_boss_definition(location_id)
    if not definition:
        raise ValueError(f"No boss definition for location: {location_id}")
    level_min = _int(definition["level_min"], 1)
    level_max = _int(definition["level_max"], level_min)
    level = _int(player_level, level_min)
    if not level_min <= level <= level_max:
        raise ValueError(f"Player level {level} is outside boss location range {level_min}-{level_max}")
    ranges = scale_boss_stat_ranges(definition, level)
    rng = rng or random
    primary_stats = {
        stat: rng.randint(ranges[f"{stat}_min"], ranges[f"{stat}_max"])
        for stat in ("str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta")
    }
    attack_type = definition.get("attack_type", "physical")
    candidate_hp = max(1, math.ceil(
        (level * 10 + primary_stats["sta"] * 5) * float(ranges["boss_hp_multiplier"])
    ))
    if attack_type == "physical":
        candidate_attack = max(1, math.ceil(level * 2 + primary_stats["str"]))
    else:
        candidate_attack = max(1, math.ceil(
            level * 2 + primary_stats["int"] + primary_stats["wis"] * 0.25
        ))
    hp = max(candidate_hp, int(ranges["elite_hp_ceiling"]) + 1)
    attack = max(candidate_attack, int(ranges["elite_attack_ceiling"]) + 1)
    pdef = max(1, math.ceil(primary_stats["sta"] * 0.5))
    mdef = max(1, math.ceil(primary_stats["wis"] * 0.75))
    return {
        "boss_schema_version": BOSS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "boss_key": definition["boss_key"], "name": definition["name"], "base_name": definition["name"],
        "level": level, "min_player_level": level, "location_id": definition["location_id"],
        "hp": hp, "max_hp": hp, "attack": attack, "pdef": pdef, "mdef": mdef,
        "def": pdef if attack_type == "physical" else mdef,
        "str": primary_stats["str"], "dex": primary_stats["dex"], "int": primary_stats["int"],
        "wis": primary_stats["wis"], "sta": primary_stats["sta"], "attack_type": attack_type,
        "is_boss": True, "is_elite": False, "enemy_type": "boss", "mob_type": "boss",
        "elite_exp_multiplier": 5.0, "elite_gold_multiplier": 5.0,
        "boss_exp_multiplier": 5.0, "boss_gold_multiplier": 5.0,
        "enemy_effects": {}, "boss_state": create_boss_state(),
        "boss_definition": copy.deepcopy(definition),
    }

def roll_boss_encounter(rng=None, chance_percent=None, enabled=None) -> bool:
    """Return whether the mutually exclusive hunt result is a boss.

    The production default is controlled by BOSS_ENCOUNTERS_ENABLED. Tests and
    future simulations can pass enabled=True explicitly without changing live
    behavior. A single random() roll is used for deterministic distribution.
    """
    if enabled is None:
        enabled = BOSS_ENCOUNTERS_ENABLED
    if not enabled:
        return False
    if chance_percent is None:
        chance_percent = BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CHANCE_PERCENT
    chance = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(chance_percent)))
    rng = rng or random
    return float(rng.random()) < chance / 100.0

def generate_hunt_encounter(
    player_level: int,
    location_id: str,
    normal_mob_factory,
    elite_modifier,
    elite_roll,
    rng=None,
    boss_enabled=None,
    boss_chance_percent=None,
    event_enabled=True,
    event_chance_percent=None,
    event_context=None,
    event_now=None,
    event_candidate_collector=None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Resolve one exclusive hunt encounter using event > boss > elite > normal.

    An active normal event candidate is checked first. If no event is selected,
    the existing boss, elite, and normal flow is called unchanged. Event mobs
    are data-only templates and are built through the canonical normal factory.
    """
    rng = rng or random
    context = {
        "player_level": int(player_level),
        "location_id": str(location_id),
    }
    if isinstance(event_context, dict):
        context.update(event_context)
    collector = event_candidate_collector or seasonal_events.collect_event_mob_candidates
    candidates = collector(context, event_now) if event_enabled else ()
    selected = seasonal_events.select_event_mob_candidate(
        candidates,
        rng=rng,
        chance_percent=event_chance_percent,
    )
    if selected is not None:
        mob = normal_mob_factory(dict(selected["mob_template"]))
        mob["enemy_type"] = "event_normal"
        mob["mob_type"] = "normal"
        mob["is_boss"] = False
        mob["is_elite"] = False
        mob["is_event"] = True
        mob["event_key"] = selected["event_key"]
        mob["event_mob_key"] = selected["mob_key"]
        return {"enemy_type": "event_normal", "mob": mob}

    if roll_boss_encounter(
        rng=rng,
        chance_percent=boss_chance_percent,
        enabled=boss_enabled,
    ):
        mob = build_location_boss(location_id, player_level, rng=rng)
        return {"enemy_type": "boss", "mob": mob}

    mob = normal_mob_factory()
    if elite_roll():
        mob = elite_modifier(mob)
        mob["enemy_type"] = "elite"
        mob["mob_type"] = "elite"
        mob["is_boss"] = False
        return {"enemy_type": "elite", "mob": mob}

    mob["enemy_type"] = "normal"
    mob["mob_type"] = "normal"
    mob["is_boss"] = False
    mob["is_elite"] = False
    return {"enemy_type": "normal", "mob": mob}

def build_boss_action_plan(boss: dict[str, Any], rng=None, forced_skill_key=None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Create a pure action plan without rolling dodge, crit or final damage."""
    definition = boss.get("boss_definition") or {}
    skills = definition.get("skills") or {}
    if forced_skill_key is None:
        selected = choose_boss_action(boss, rng=rng)
        skill_key = selected["skill_key"]
        skill = dict(selected["skill"])
        phase = selected["phase"]
    else:
        skill_key = str(forced_skill_key)
        skill = dict(skills.get(skill_key) or {})
        if not skill:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown boss skill: {skill_key}")
        phase = "forced"
    no_damage = bool(skill.get("no_damage"))
    return {
        "boss_key": boss.get("boss_key"),
        "skill_key": skill_key,
        "skill_name": skill.get("name", skill_key),
        "phase": phase,
        "no_damage": no_damage,
        "attack_type": None if no_damage else skill.get("attack_type", boss.get("attack_type", "physical")),
        "damage_multiplier": 0.0 if no_damage else float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0) or 0.0),
        "effective_attack": 0 if no_damage else get_effective_boss_attack(boss),
        "skill": skill,
    }

def apply_boss_action_effects(
    boss: dict[str, Any],
    action_plan: Mapping[str, Any],
    actual_damage: int = 0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Apply boss self-buffs and return a player-effect instruction.

    The returned player_effect is intentionally data-only. The production
    handler integration in the next stage will insert it into player_effects.
    """
    state = _boss_state(boss)
    skill = dict(action_plan.get("skill") or {})
    skill_key = str(action_plan.get("skill_key") or "")
    events = []
    player_effect = None

    if "attack_buff_percent" in skill:
        state["attack_buff_percent"] = float(skill.get("attack_buff_percent", 0) or 0)
        state["attack_buff_turns"] = max(0, int(skill.get("duration_turns", 0) or 0))
        events.append({
            "type": "boss_attack_buff",
            "percent": state["attack_buff_percent"],
            "turns": state["attack_buff_turns"],
            "refresh_policy": skill.get("refresh_policy", "replace"),
        })

    if "pdef_buff_percent" in skill or "mdef_buff_percent" in skill:
        state["physical_defense_buff_percent"] = float(skill.get("pdef_buff_percent", 0) or 0)
        state["magical_defense_buff_percent"] = float(skill.get("mdef_buff_percent", 0) or 0)
        state["defense_buff_turns"] = max(0, int(skill.get("duration_turns", 0) or 0))
        events.append({
            "type": "boss_defense_buff",
            "pdef_percent": state["physical_defense_buff_percent"],
            "mdef_percent": state["magical_defense_buff_percent"],
            "turns": state["defense_buff_turns"],
            "refresh_policy": skill.get("refresh_policy", "replace"),
        })

    bleed_damage = calculate_boss_bleed_damage(actual_damage, skill)
    if bleed_damage > 0:
        player_effect = {
            "key": PLAYER_BOSS_BLEED_EFFECT_KEY,
            "name": "🩸 Кровотеча",
            "icon": "🩸",
            "type": "dot",
            "source": "boss",
            "source_boss_key": boss.get("boss_key"),
            "source_skill_key": skill_key,
            "turns": max(1, int(skill.get("bleed_turns", 1) or 1)),
            "damage": bleed_damage,
            "can_crit": False,
            "refresh_policy": skill.get("bleed_refresh_policy", "replace"),
        }
        events.append({
            "type": "player_bleed_applied",
            "damage": bleed_damage,
            "turns": player_effect["turns"],
            "refresh_policy": player_effect["refresh_policy"],
        })

    state["last_action_key"] = skill_key
    return {
        "boss_state": copy.deepcopy(state),
        "events": events,
        "player_effect": player_effect,
    }

def apply_player_effect_instruction(mob: dict[str, Any], effect_instruction: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Insert/refresh the boss bleed instruction in combat player_effects."""
    if not effect_instruction:
        return None
    effect = dict(effect_instruction)
    key = str(effect.pop("key", PLAYER_BOSS_BLEED_EFFECT_KEY))
    effects = mob.setdefault("player_effects", {})
    effects[key] = effect
    return effect

def process_boss_player_dots(mob: dict[str, Any], current_hp: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Tick only boss-origin player DoTs at player-turn start.

    This helper does not write game.db. It mutates the in-memory combat object
    and returns the new HP so the handler can use its existing HP persistence.
    """
    hp = max(0, int(current_hp or 0))
    effects = mob.setdefault("player_effects", {})
    total_damage = 0
    events = []
    expired = []
    for key, effect in list(effects.items()):
        if effect.get("type") != "dot" or effect.get("source") != "boss":
            continue
        damage = max(0, int(effect.get("damage", 0) or 0))
        applied = min(hp, damage)
        hp -= applied
        total_damage += applied
        turns = int(effect.get("turns", 0) or 0) - 1
        effect["turns"] = turns
        events.append({"type": "boss_dot_tick", "key": key, "damage": applied, "turns_left": max(0, turns)})
        if turns <= 0:
            expired.append(key)
    for key in expired:
        effects.pop(key, None)
    return {"current_hp": hp, "damage": total_damage, "events": events, "expired": expired}

def resolve_boss_combat_action(
    boss: dict[str, Any],
    rng=None,
    forced_skill_key=None,
    actual_damage: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Resolve action selection and effects around the existing damage engine.

    If actual_damage is None, the caller must calculate final damage through the
    existing production calculate_mob_attack() and call apply_boss_action_effects
    afterwards. Tests may pass actual_damage to verify bleed semantics.
    """
    plan = build_boss_action_plan(boss, rng=rng, forced_skill_key=forced_skill_key)
    effects = None
    if actual_damage is not None or plan["no_damage"]:
        effects = apply_boss_action_effects(boss, plan, actual_damage=int(actual_damage or 0))
    return {"plan": plan, "effects": effects}

def init_character_class_system():

    db = _db()

    migrations = [

        ("character_name", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("class_change_available", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),

        try:

            pass

    db.conn.commit()

    return True

def refresh_user_mp(user_id):

    init_character_class_system()

    db = _db()

    maximum = get_max_mp(user_id)

    db.cursor.execute("SELECT mp, max_mp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))

    row = db.cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:

        return 0

    current = int(row[0] or 0)

    old_max = int(row[1] or 0)

    if maximum <= 0:

        current = 0

    elif old_max <= 0 and current <= 0:

        current = maximum

    else:

        current = min(current, maximum)

    db.cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET mp=?, max_mp=? WHERE user_id=?", (current, maximum, user_id))

    db.conn.commit()

    return current

def build_mob(mob_template):
    # Build one canonical mob snapshot from one primary-stat roll.
    import math

    level = int(mob_template["level"])
    attack_type = mob_template.get("attack_type", "physical")
    primary_stats = {
        stat: random.randint(
            int(mob_template[f"{stat}_min"]),
            int(mob_template[f"{stat}_max"]),
        )
        for stat in ("str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta")
    }

    hp = max(1, int(math.ceil((level * 10) + (primary_stats["sta"] * 5))))
    if attack_type == "physical":
        attack = max(1, int(math.ceil((level * 2) + primary_stats["str"])))
    else:
        attack = max(1, int(math.ceil(
            (level * 2) + primary_stats["int"] + (primary_stats["wis"] * 0.25)
        )))
    pdef = max(1, int(math.ceil(primary_stats["sta"] * 0.5)))
    mdef = max(1, int(math.ceil(primary_stats["wis"] * 0.75)))

    return {
        "name": mob_template["name"],
        "base_name": mob_template["name"],
        "level": level,
        "location_id": mob_template.get("location_id", "start_path"),
        "hp": hp,
        "max_hp": hp,
        "attack": attack,
        "pdef": pdef,
        "mdef": mdef,
        "def": pdef if attack_type == "physical" else mdef,
        "str": primary_stats["str"],
        "dex": primary_stats["dex"],
        "int": primary_stats["int"],
        "wis": primary_stats["wis"],
        "sta": primary_stats["sta"],
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "min_gold": mob_template.get("min_gold", 0),
        "max_gold": mob_template.get("max_gold", 0),
        "loot_chance": mob_template.get("loot_chance", 0),
        "trash_items": mob_template.get("trash_items", []),
        "is_elite": False,
        "elite_exp_multiplier": 1.0,
        "elite_gold_multiplier": 1.0,
    }

def apply_elite_modifier(mob):
    old_name = mob["name"]

    mob["name"] = f"⭐ Елітний {old_name}"
    mob["base_name"] = old_name

    mob["hp"] = int(mob["hp"] * ELITE_HP_MULTIPLIER)
    mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

    mob["attack"] = int(mob["attack"] * ELITE_ATTACK_MULTIPLIER)

    mob["pdef"] = max(1, int(round(mob["pdef"] * ELITE_CORE_STAT_MULTIPLIER)))
    mob["mdef"] = max(1, int(round(mob["mdef"] * ELITE_CORE_STAT_MULTIPLIER)))
    mob["dex"] = max(1, int(round(mob["dex"] * ELITE_CORE_STAT_MULTIPLIER)))
    mob["def"] = mob["pdef"] if mob.get("attack_type", "physical") == "physical" else mob["mdef"]

    mob["is_elite"] = True
    mob["elite_exp_multiplier"] = ELITE_EXP_MULTIPLIER
    mob["elite_gold_multiplier"] = ELITE_GOLD_MULTIPLIER

    return mob

def calculate_player_attack(
    player_stat_attack,
    mob_def,
    dex,
    wis,
    level,
    attack_type="physical",
    weapon_min_damage=0,
    weapon_max_damage=0,
    weapon_subtype=""
):
    weapon_min_damage = int(weapon_min_damage or 0)
    weapon_max_damage = int(weapon_max_damage or 0)

    if weapon_max_damage < weapon_min_damage:
        weapon_max_damage = weapon_min_damage

    weapon_damage = 0

    if weapon_max_damage > 0:
        weapon_subtype = str(weapon_subtype or "").strip().lower()
        effective_min = weapon_min_damage
        effective_max = weapon_max_damage
        if weapon_subtype == "bow_2h":
            # Bow identity: higher floor and lower peak for stable damage.
            effective_min = max(1, int(round(weapon_min_damage * 1.05)))
            effective_max = max(effective_min, int(round(weapon_max_damage * 0.95)))
        elif weapon_subtype == "crossbow_2h":
            # Crossbow identity: lower floor and higher peak for risky damage.
            effective_min = max(1, int(round(weapon_min_damage * 0.85)))
            effective_max = max(effective_min, int(round(weapon_max_damage * 1.15)))
        weapon_damage = random.randint(effective_min, effective_max)

    base_damage = weapon_damage + player_stat_attack - (mob_def * 0.5)

    if base_damage < 1:
        base_damage = 1

    if attack_type == "magical":
        crit_chance = get_magical_crit_chance(wis, level)
    else:
        crit_chance = get_physical_crit_chance(dex, level)

    is_crit = roll_chance(crit_chance, random)

    if is_crit:
        base_damage *= CRITICAL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER

    damage = max(1, int(round(base_damage)))

    return {
        "damage": damage,
        "is_crit": is_crit,
        "crit_chance": crit_chance,
        "weapon_damage": weapon_damage,
        "attack_type": attack_type
    }

def calculate_mob_attack(
    mob_attack,
    player_pdef,
    player_mdef,
    player_dex,
    mob_dex,
    sta,
    level,
    attack_type="physical"
):
    dodge_chance = get_dodge_chance(
        player_dex=player_dex,
        mob_dex=mob_dex,
        level=level
    )

    is_dodge = roll_chance(dodge_chance, random)

    if is_dodge:
        return {
            "damage": 0,
            "is_crit": False,
            "is_dodge": True,
            "dodge_chance": dodge_chance
        }

    if attack_type == "magical":
        defense = player_mdef
    else:
        defense = player_pdef

    damage = mob_attack - (defense * 0.5)

    if damage < 1:
        damage = 1

    enemy_crit_chance = calculate_enemy_crit_chance(sta)
    is_crit = roll_chance(enemy_crit_chance, random)

    if is_crit:
        damage *= CRITICAL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER

    damage = max(1, int(round(damage)))

    return {
        "damage": damage,
        "is_crit": is_crit,
        "is_dodge": False,
        "dodge_chance": dodge_chance
    }

def init_contract_system():
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_active_contracts (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        created_date TEXT,
        player_level INTEGER,

        target_mob_name TEXT,
        target_mob_level INTEGER,

        target_min_level INTEGER,
        target_max_level INTEGER,

        target_kills INTEGER,
        current_kills INTEGER,
        reward_exp INTEGER,

        completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        reward_claimed INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    migrations = [
        ("users", "daily_contracts_completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_contract_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("user_active_contracts", "target_mob_name", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("user_active_contracts", "target_mob_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("user_active_contracts", "target_min_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("user_active_contracts", "target_max_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("user_active_contracts", "completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("user_active_contracts", "reward_claimed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM user_active_contracts
        WHERE target_mob_name IS NULL OR target_mob_name = ''
        """)
    except Exception:
        pass

    conn.commit()

def create_daily_contract(
    user_id,
    target_mob_name,
    target_mob_level,
    target_kills=CONTRACT_TARGET_KILLS
):
    reset_daily_contracts_if_needed(user_id)

    status = get_contract_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено"
        }

    level = status["level"]

    if level < CONTRACTS_UNLOCK_LEVEL:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"🔒 Контракти відкриються з {CONTRACTS_UNLOCK_LEVEL} рівня.\n"
                f"Твій рівень: {level}"
            )
        }

    if status["completed_today"] >= DAILY_CONTRACT_LIMIT:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"📜 Ліміт контрактів на сьогодні виконано.\n"
                f"✅ Виконано: {status['completed_today']}/{DAILY_CONTRACT_LIMIT}"
            )
        }

    if status["active_contract"]:
        active = status["active_contract"]

        if active.get("completed"):
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    "📜 У тебе вже є виконаний контракт.\n\n"
                    "Повернися до Гільдії Найманців і здай його, "
                    "щоб отримати нагороду."
                )
            }

        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "📜 У тебе вже є активний контракт."
        }

    reward_exp = get_contract_exp_for_level(level)

    target_min_level = max(1, level - 1)
    target_max_level = level + 1

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO user_active_contracts (
        user_id,
        created_date,
        player_level,
        target_mob_name,
        target_mob_level,
        target_min_level,
        target_max_level,
        target_kills,
        current_kills,
        reward_exp,
        completed,
        reward_claimed
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        get_today_str(),
        level,
        target_mob_name,
        int(target_mob_level),
        target_min_level,
        target_max_level,
        int(target_kills),
        0,
        reward_exp,
        0,
        0
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"📜 Контракт прийнято!\n\n"
            f"🎯 Завдання:\n"
            f"Вбий {target_kills} × {target_mob_name} "
            f"(рівень {target_mob_level}).\n\n"
            f"✨ Нагорода після здачі: {reward_exp} EXP"
        )
    }

def roll_drop_group(group, mob, random_func, context=None, rules=None):

    """Pure roll of all enabled rules in a group, respecting max_per_kill."""

    selected = [

        rule for rule in (DROP_RULES if rules is None else rules)

        if rule.get("group") == group

    ]

    results = []

    hits = 0

    for rule in selected:

        if hits >= int(rule.get("max_per_kill", 1)):

            results.append(make_drop_result(rule, classify_enemy(mob), False, reason="group_limit"))

            continue

        result = roll_drop_rule(rule, mob, random_func, context=context)

        results.append(result)

        if result["rolled"]:

            hits += 1

    return results

def resolve_central_trophy_chance(mob):

    """Resolve the legacy trophy chance through the canonical trophy rule.



    The pre-Stage-11 runtime adds +20 percentage points only when `is_elite`

    is truthy. Bosses had no independent trophy balance. Preserve that exact

    behavior during migration, while recording the boss path explicitly.

    """

    rule = get_drop_rule("trophy")

    if rule is None:

        raise RuntimeError("central trophy rule is missing")

    if not rule.get("production_enabled", False):

        raise RuntimeError("central trophy rule is not production-enabled")



    enemy_type = classify_enemy(mob)

    base_chance = float((mob or {}).get("loot_chance", 0.45))

    elite_bonus = 0.20 if bool((mob or {}).get("is_elite", False)) else 0.0

    chance = min(1.0, base_chance + elite_bonus)

    return {

        "enemy_type": enemy_type,

        "chance": chance,

        "base_chance": base_chance,

        "elite_flag_bonus": elite_bonus,

        "boss_policy": "legacy_elite_flag_compatibility" if enemy_type == "boss" else None,

    }

def reset_daily_hunts_if_needed(user_id):
    """Reset only the daily hunt counter when the calendar date changes."""

    today = get_today_str()
    row = cursor.execute(

        (user_id,)

    cursor.execute(

        (today, user_id)

    conn.commit()
    return True

        "COALESCE(inv.quantity,1) AS quantity, COALESCE(inv.durability,100) AS durability, "

        "COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0) AS refine_level, it.name, it.type, it.rarity, "

        "it.category, it.slot_key AS item_slot_key, COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1) AS weapon_hands, "

        "COALESCE(it.max_stack,1) AS max_stack, COALESCE(it.sell_price,0) AS sell_price, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_str,0) AS bonus_str, COALESCE(it.bonus_dex,0) AS bonus_dex, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_int,0) AS bonus_int, COALESCE(it.bonus_wis,0) AS bonus_wis, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_sta,0) AS bonus_sta, COALESCE(it.pdef,0) AS pdef, "

        "COALESCE(it.mdef,0) AS mdef, COALESCE(it.item_level,0) AS item_level, "

        "COALESCE(it.item_subtype,'') AS item_subtype, COALESCE(it.armor_type,'') AS armor_type, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_min_damage,0) AS weapon_min_damage, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_max_damage,0) AS weapon_max_damage, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_min_magic_damage,0) AS weapon_min_magic_damage, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_max_magic_damage,0) AS weapon_max_magic_damage, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_attack_type,'') AS weapon_attack_type "

        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id WHERE inv.id=?",

        (int(inventory_id),),

    )

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:

        return None

    columns = [col[0] for col in cursor.description]

    item = dict(zip(columns, row))

    item["slot_key"] = slot_key

    item["equipped_slot"] = slot_key

    item["id"] = item["inventory_id"]

    item["inv_id"] = item["inventory_id"]

    item["item_name"] = item["name"]

    item["level"] = item["item_level"]

    item["b_str"] = item["bonus_str"]

    item["b_dex"] = item["bonus_dex"]

    item["b_int"] = item["bonus_int"]

    item["b_wis"] = item["bonus_wis"]

    item["b_sta"] = item["bonus_sta"]

    try:

        display_name = db.get_inventory_refined_display_name(int(inventory_id))

        if display_name:

            item["name"] = display_name

            item["item_name"] = display_name

    except Exception:

        pass

    return item

def get_all_equipped_items(user_id):

    """

    Return the historical equipment contract used by repair code:



        [{

            "slot_key": str,

            "slot_name": str,

            "inventory_id": int | None,

            "item": tuple(19 fields) | None,

            ...flat aliases...

        }, ...]



    All ten slots are returned, including empty slots. Newer callers can use

    the flat aliases; old repair code can use the nested ``item`` tuple.

    """

    db = _equipment_real_db_v1()

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    uid = int(user_id)



    rows = db.conn.execute(

        "SELECT "

        "es.slot_key AS equipped_slot_key, es.inventory_id AS equipped_inventory_id, "

        "inv.id AS inventory_id, inv.user_id AS inventory_user_id, "

        "inv.item_id AS item_id, inv.quantity AS quantity, "

        "inv.durability AS durability, COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0) AS refine_level, "

        "it.name AS item_name, it.type AS item_type, it.rarity AS rarity, "

        "it.category AS category, it.slot_key AS item_slot_key, "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1) AS weapon_hands, "

        "COALESCE(it.max_stack,1) AS max_stack, COALESCE(it.sell_price,0) AS sell_price, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_str,0) AS bonus_str, COALESCE(it.bonus_dex,0) AS bonus_dex, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_int,0) AS bonus_int, COALESCE(it.bonus_wis,0) AS bonus_wis, "

        "COALESCE(it.bonus_sta,0) AS bonus_sta, COALESCE(it.pdef,0) AS pdef, "

        "COALESCE(it.mdef,0) AS mdef "

        "FROM equipment_slots es "

        "LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id "

        "LEFT JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "

        "WHERE es.user_id=? "

        "ORDER BY CASE es.slot_key "

        "WHEN 'main_hand' THEN 1 WHEN 'off_hand' THEN 2 "

        "WHEN 'helmet' THEN 3 WHEN 'shoulders' THEN 4 "

        "WHEN 'chest' THEN 5 WHEN 'gloves' THEN 6 "

        "WHEN 'legs' THEN 7 WHEN 'boots' THEN 8 "

        "WHEN 'necklace' THEN 9 WHEN 'ring' THEN 10 ELSE 99 END",

        (uid,),

    ).fetchall()



    result = []

    for raw in rows:

        row = dict(raw) if hasattr(raw, "keys") else None

        if row is None:

            columns = (

                "equipped_slot_key", "equipped_inventory_id", "inventory_id",

                "inventory_user_id", "item_id", "quantity", "durability",

                "refine_level", "item_name", "item_type", "rarity", "category",

                "item_slot_key", "weapon_hands", "max_stack", "sell_price",

                "bonus_str", "bonus_dex", "bonus_int", "bonus_wis", "bonus_sta",

                "pdef", "mdef",

            )

            row = dict(zip(columns, raw))



        slot_key = str(row.get("equipped_slot_key") or "")

        slot_name = _EQUIPMENT_SLOT_NAMES_REAL_V2.get(slot_key, slot_key)

        inventory_id = row.get("inventory_id")



        if inventory_id is None:

            result.append({

                "slot_key": slot_key,

                "slot_name": slot_name,

                "inventory_id": None,

                "item": None,

                "name": None,

                "durability": None,

                "refine_level": 0,

            })

            continue



        display_name = _equipment_refined_name_real_v2(

            db,

            inventory_id,

            row.get("item_name"),

            row.get("refine_level"),

        )

        nested_item = _equipment_nested_item_tuple_real_v2(row, display_name)



        result.append({

            "slot_key": slot_key,

            "slot_name": slot_name,

            "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),

            "item": nested_item,

            "id": int(inventory_id),

            "inv_id": int(inventory_id),

            "user_id": int(row.get("inventory_user_id") or uid),

            "item_id": int(row.get("item_id") or 0),

            "name": display_name,

            "item_name": display_name,

            "type": row.get("item_type"),

            "rarity": row.get("rarity"),

            "category": row.get("category"),

            "item_slot_key": row.get("item_slot_key"),

            "weapon_hands": int(row.get("weapon_hands") or 1),

            "quantity": int(row.get("quantity") or 1),

            "max_stack": int(row.get("max_stack") or 1),

            "durability": int(row.get("durability") if row.get("durability") is not None else 100),

            "refine_level": int(row.get("refine_level") or 0),

            "sell_price": float(row.get("sell_price") or 0.0),

            "bonus_str": int(row.get("bonus_str") or 0),

            "bonus_dex": int(row.get("bonus_dex") or 0),

            "bonus_int": int(row.get("bonus_int") or 0),

            "bonus_wis": int(row.get("bonus_wis") or 0),

            "bonus_sta": int(row.get("bonus_sta") or 0),

            "pdef": int(row.get("pdef") or 0),

            "mdef": int(row.get("mdef") or 0),

        })



    return result

def _inventory_read_rows_v3(user_id=None, inventory_id=None, full=False, short=False):

            "COALESCE(it.bonus_str,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_dex,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.bonus_int,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_wis,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.bonus_sta,0), COALESCE(it.pdef,0), COALESCE(it.mdef,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.sell_price,0), COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0) "

        )

    else:

        select_sql = (

            "SELECT inv.id, inv.item_id, it.name, it.type, it.rarity, it.category, "

            "COALESCE(inv.quantity,1), COALESCE(it.max_stack,1), "

            "COALESCE(inv.durability,100), COALESCE(it.bonus_str,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.bonus_dex,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_int,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.bonus_wis,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_sta,0), "

            "COALESCE(it.pdef,0), COALESCE(it.mdef,0), COALESCE(it.sell_price,0), "

            "COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0) "

        )



    sql = select_sql + "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "

    params = []

    where = []

    if user_id is not None:

        where.append("inv.user_id=?")

        params.append(int(user_id))

    if inventory_id is not None:

        where.append("inv.id=?")

        params.append(int(inventory_id))

    if where:

        sql += "WHERE " + " AND ".join(where) + " "

    sql += "ORDER BY inv.id ASC"

    return db.conn.execute(sql, tuple(params)).fetchall()

def get_effective_weapon_display_range_17_18_2_5(minimum, maximum, item_subtype):
    """Return the effective combat range shown by all weapon preview surfaces."""
    minimum = max(0, int(minimum or 0))
    maximum = max(minimum, int(maximum or 0))
    subtype = str(item_subtype or "").strip().lower()
    if maximum <= 0:
        return minimum, maximum
    if subtype == "bow_2h":
        effective_min = max(1, int(round(minimum * 1.05)))
        effective_max = max(effective_min, int(round(maximum * 0.95)))
        return effective_min, effective_max
    if subtype == "crossbow_2h":
        effective_min = max(1, int(round(minimum * 0.85)))
        effective_max = max(effective_min, int(round(maximum * 1.15)))
        return effective_min, effective_max
    return minimum, maximum

def get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):

    """Return the established weapon-damage dict, including refine multiplier."""

    init_weapon_damage_system()

    db = _weapon_damage_db_v4()

    row = db.conn.execute(

        "SELECT it.name, it.category, it.slot_key, COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1), "

        "it.rarity, COALESCE(it.item_level,1), "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_min_damage,0), COALESCE(it.weapon_max_damage,0), "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_min_magic_damage,0), COALESCE(it.weapon_max_magic_damage,0), "

        "COALESCE(it.weapon_attack_type,''), COALESCE(it.item_subtype,''), "

        "COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0) "

        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id WHERE inv.id=?",

        (int(inventory_id),),

    ).fetchone()

    if not row:

        return _weapon_damage_empty_result_v4()



    (

        name, category, slot_key, weapon_hands, rarity, item_level,

        physical_min, physical_max, magic_min, magic_max,

        weapon_attack_type, item_subtype, refine_level,

    ) = row



    if category != "equipment" or slot_key != "main_hand":

        return _weapon_damage_empty_result_v4()



    is_magical = _weapon_is_magical_v4(name, item_subtype, weapon_attack_type)

    attack_type = "magical" if is_magical else "physical"



    if is_magical:

        base_min = int(magic_min or 0)

        base_max = int(magic_max or 0)

        if base_min <= 0 or base_max <= 0:

            base_min, base_max = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(item_level, rarity, weapon_hands)

        final_min, final_max = _weapon_damage_apply_refine_v4(base_min, base_max, refine_level)

        return {

            "is_weapon": True,

            "attack_type": attack_type,

            "item_subtype": str(item_subtype or "").strip().lower(),

            "physical_min": 0,

            "physical_max": 0,

            "magic_min": final_min,

            "magic_max": final_max,

            "text": f"🔮 Маг. шкода: {final_min}-{final_max}",

        }



    base_min = int(physical_min or 0)

    base_max = int(physical_max or 0)

    if base_min <= 0 or base_max <= 0:

        base_min, base_max = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(item_level, rarity, weapon_hands)

    final_min, final_max = _weapon_damage_apply_refine_v4(base_min, base_max, refine_level)

    return {

        "is_weapon": True,

        "attack_type": attack_type,

            "item_subtype": str(item_subtype or "").strip().lower(),

        "physical_min": final_min,

        "physical_max": final_max,

        "magic_min": 0,

        "magic_max": 0,

        "text": f"⚔️ Шкода: {get_effective_weapon_display_range_17_18_2_5(final_min, final_max, item_subtype)[0]}-{get_effective_weapon_display_range_17_18_2_5(final_min, final_max, item_subtype)[1]}",

    }

def repair_equipped_item(user_id, inventory_id):

    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()

    user_id = int(user_id)

    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)

    row = db.conn.execute(

        """

        SELECT inv.durability, COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0), i.name, i.rarity

        FROM equipment_slots es

        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id

        JOIN items i ON i.id=inv.item_id

        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id=?

        LIMIT 1

        """,

        (user_id, inventory_id),

    ).fetchone()

    if not row:

        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей предмет не вдягнений або не належить персонажу."}



    old_durability = 100 if row[0] is None else max(0, min(100, int(row[0])))

    name = _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, row[2])

    rarity = str(row[3] or "common")

    cost = calculate_repair_cost(old_durability, rarity)

    if old_durability >= 100 or cost <= 0:

        return {"success": False, "message": f"ℹ️ {name} уже має максимальну міцність.", "inventory_id": inventory_id}



    try:

        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        wallet = _equipment_wallet_9_0_12h2(db, user_id)

        if wallet + 1e-9 < cost:

            db.conn.rollback()

            return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {cost:.2f} 💰"}

        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=gold-? WHERE user_id=?", (cost, user_id))

        db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=100 WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (inventory_id, user_id))

        db.conn.commit()

    except Exception:

        db.conn.rollback()

        raise



    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)

    message = (

        "✅ Предмет відремонтовано.\n\n"

        f"📦 {name}\n"

        f"🛠️ Міцність: {old_durability}/100 → 100/100\n"

        f"💳 Сплачено: {cost:.2f} 💰 золото"

    )

    return {

        "success": True,

        "message": message,

        "inventory_id": inventory_id,

        "name": name,

        "old_durability": old_durability,

        "new_durability": 100,

        "cost": cost,

    }

def damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=1):

    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()

    user_id = int(user_id)

    amount = max(0, int(amount or 0))

    if amount <= 0:

        return {"success": True, "damaged": 0, "amount": 0, "items": []}

    rows = db.conn.execute(

        """

        SELECT inv.id, COALESCE(inv.durability, 100), i.name

        FROM equipment_slots es

        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id

        JOIN items i ON i.id=inv.item_id

        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL

        """,

        (user_id,),

    ).fetchall()

    changed = []

    try:

        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        for inv_id, old_value, base_name in rows:

            old_value = max(0, min(100, int(old_value or 0)))

            new_value = max(0, old_value - amount)

            if new_value == old_value:

                continue

            db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (new_value, int(inv_id), user_id))

            changed.append({

                "inventory_id": int(inv_id),

                "name": _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inv_id, base_name),

                "old_durability": old_value,

                "new_durability": new_value,

                "is_broken": new_value <= 0,

            })

        db.conn.commit()

    except Exception:

        db.conn.rollback()

        raise

    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)

    return {"success": True, "damaged": len(changed), "amount": amount, "items": changed}

def apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(user_id, chance_percent=25, **kwargs):

    """

    Historical public contract used by build_victory_text():

    {triggered: bool, message: str | None}.



    On a successful roll exactly one equipped, non-broken item loses 1 durability.

    """

    import random



    try:

        chance_percent = int(chance_percent)

    except Exception:

        chance_percent = 25

    chance_percent = max(0, min(100, chance_percent))



    roll = random.randint(1, 100)

    if roll > chance_percent:

        return {"triggered": False, "message": None}



    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()

    rows = db.conn.execute(

        "SELECT es.slot_key, inv.id, COALESCE(inv.durability,100), it.name "

        "FROM equipment_slots es "

        "JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id "

        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "

        "WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL "

        "AND COALESCE(inv.durability,100)>0",

        (int(user_id),),

    ).fetchall()



    if not rows:

        return {"triggered": False, "message": None}



    slot_key, inventory_id, old_durability, base_name = random.choice(rows)

    old_durability = max(0, min(100, int(old_durability or 0)))

    new_durability = max(0, old_durability - 1)



    db.conn.execute(

        "UPDATE inventory SET durability=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",

        (new_durability, int(inventory_id), int(user_id)),

    )

    db.conn.commit()

    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)



    name = _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, base_name)

    slot_name = _SLOT_NAMES_9_0_12H2.get(str(slot_key), str(slot_key))

    broken_text = " Предмет зламано!" if new_durability <= 0 else ""

    message = (

        f"🧱 {slot_name}: {name} втратив 1 міцності "

        f"({old_durability} → {new_durability}/100).{broken_text}"

    )

    return {

        "triggered": True,

        "message": message,

        "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),

        "name": name,

        "slot_key": str(slot_key),

        "old": old_durability,

        "new": new_durability,

        "broken": new_durability <= 0,

    }

def sell_inventory_item_to_trader(user_id, inventory_id):

    """Atomically remove one owned, unequipped equipment row and credit its sell price."""

    db = _trader_db_9_0_12h3()

    uid = int(user_id)

    iid = int(inventory_id)

    try:

        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        row = db.conn.execute(

            "SELECT inv.item_id, COALESCE(inv.quantity,1), COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0), "

            "it.name, it.category, COALESCE(it.sell_price,0) "

            "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "

            "WHERE inv.id=? AND inv.user_id=?",

            (iid, uid),

        ).fetchone()

        if not row:

            db.conn.rollback()

            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено або його вже продано."}

        item_id, quantity, refine_level, base_name, category, sell_price = row

        if category != "equipment":

            db.conn.rollback()

            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Торговець приймає тут лише спорядження."}

        equipped = db.conn.execute(

            "SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND inventory_id=? LIMIT 1",

            (uid, iid),

        ).fetchone()

        if equipped:

            db.conn.rollback()

            return {

                "success": False,

                "message": "❌ Неможливо продати вдягнений предмет.\n\nСпочатку зніми його з персонажа.",

            }

        quantity = max(1, int(quantity or 1))

        earned = round(float(sell_price or 0.0) * quantity, 2)

        name = _trader_display_name_9_0_12h3(iid, base_name)

        deleted = db.conn.execute(

            "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",

            (iid, uid),

        )

        if deleted.rowcount != 1:

            db.conn.rollback()

            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет уже продано. Золото не нараховано."}

        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=COALESCE(gold,0)+? WHERE user_id=?", (earned, uid))

        db.conn.commit()

    except Exception:

        db.conn.rollback()

        raise

    return {

        "success": True,

        "message": f"✅ Продано: {name}\n💰 Отримано: {earned:.2f} золота",

        "inventory_id": iid,

        "item_id": int(item_id),

        "name": name,

        "quantity": quantity,

        "refine_level": int(refine_level or 0),

        "earned": earned,

        "sell_price": earned,

    }

def get_registered_event_item_definitions():
    import events
    # Registry loading is explicit. A fresh interpreter has an empty runtime
    # registry even though EVENT_MODULES contains the production package.
    events.load_event_modules()
    collector = getattr(events, "collect_registered_event_items", None)
    if not callable(collector):
        raise RuntimeError("events.collect_registered_event_items is unavailable")
    definitions = tuple(collector())
    from events.item_namespace import validate_event_item_definitions
    return validate_event_item_definitions(definitions)

def archive_and_reset_guild_monthly_stats(guild_row, new_season_key=None):
    """
    Архівує минулий місяць у guild_season_history і обнуляє monthly counters.
    """

    if not guild_row:
        return False

    if new_season_key is None:
        new_season_key = get_current_guild_season_key()

    guild_id = guild_row["id"]
    old_season_key = guild_row["season_key"]

    if old_season_key == new_season_key:
        return False

    finished_at = now_iso()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO guild_season_history (
        guild_id,
        season_key,
        monthly_exp,
        monthly_resource,
        monthly_kills,
        monthly_contracts,
        monthly_score,
        finished_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        old_season_key,
        int(guild_row["monthly_exp"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_resource"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_kills"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_contracts"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_score"] or 0),
        finished_at,
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guilds
    SET monthly_exp=0,
        monthly_resource=0,
        monthly_kills=0,
        monthly_contracts=0,
        monthly_score=0,
        season_key=?,
        updated_at=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        new_season_key,
        finished_at,
        guild_id,
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_members
    SET monthly_contribution_exp=0,
        monthly_contribution_resource=0,
        monthly_contribution_kills=0,
        monthly_contribution_contracts=0,
        monthly_contribution_score=0
    WHERE guild_id=?
    """, (
        guild_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="season_reset",
        text=f"Почався новий сезон рейтингу: {new_season_key}. Попередній сезон {old_season_key} збережено в історії."
    )

    return True

def _guild_safe_set_application_status(application_id, status, processed_by=None):
    """
    Безпечно змінює статус заявки з урахуванням UNIQUE(guild_id, user_id, status).

    Якщо запис із таким status уже існує, поточна заявка видаляється,
    щоб не ламати БД і не залишати pending-дублікат.
    """

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)
    if not app:
        return False

    now = now_iso()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (
            status,
            now,
            processed_by,
            application_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()
        return True
    except Exception as error:
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" not in str(error):
            raise

        # Є інша заявка з таким самим guild_id/user_id/status.
        # Поточний pending-запис більше не потрібен.
        cursor.execute("DELETE FROM guild_applications WHERE id=?", (application_id,))
        conn.commit()
        return True

    Empty, invalid, or unavailable names intentionally produce an empty string,
    so Guild events keep their previous text without exposing a technical ID.

        actor_name = str(actor_name).strip()
        return actor_name

        return ""

def get_guild_diagnostics(user_id):
    """
    Technical diagnostics for /guild_debug.
    Safe read-only helper.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    diagnostics = {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "season_key": get_current_guild_season_key(),
        "has_guild": False,
        "guild": None,
        "member": None,
        "member_count": 0,
        "pending_applications": 0,
        "user_pending_applications": 0,
        "officer_count": 0,
        "next_level_info": None,
    }

    try:
        member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)
        diagnostics["member"] = member
        diagnostics["user_pending_applications"] = get_user_pending_applications_count(user_id)

        if not member:
            return diagnostics

        guild = get_guild_by_id(member["guild_id"])
        diagnostics["guild"] = guild
        diagnostics["has_guild"] = bool(guild)

        if guild:
            ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["member_count"] = get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["pending_applications"] = get_guild_pending_applications_count(guild["id"])

            try:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = get_guild_officer_count(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = 0

            try:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = get_guild_next_level_info(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = None

    except Exception as error:
        diagnostics["error"] = str(error)

    return diagnostics

def calculate_level_reward(reached_level):

    level = int(reached_level)

    if level not in LEVEL_UP_GOLD_BY_REACHED_LEVEL:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Level-up gold is not configured for reached level {level}. "
            "Add an audited combat-income matrix before enabling this level."
        )

    milestone = level % 5 == 0

    return {

        "reached_level": level,

        "gold": LEVEL_UP_GOLD_BY_REACHED_LEVEL[level],

        "small_health_potions": 3,

        "small_mana_potions": 1,

        "refine_stones": 4 if milestone else 2,

        "medium_health_potions": 2 if milestone else 0,

        "medium_mana_potions": 1 if milestone else 0,

        "crystals": 0,

        "milestone": milestone,

    }

def get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, stat_column):
    """
    Повертає сумарний бонус екіпірування для конкретної характеристики.
    Враховує тільки вдягнені предмети з durability > 0.
    """

    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"""
        SELECT items.{stat_column}, inventory.durability
        FROM equipment_slots
        JOIN inventory ON equipment_slots.inventory_id = inventory.id
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE equipment_slots.user_id=?
          AND equipment_slots.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """, (user_id,)).fetchall()
    except Exception:
        return 0

    total = 0

    for bonus, durability in rows:
        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            continue

        total += bonus or 0

    return total

def get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id):
    """Calculate worker max HP from the shared canonical HP policy."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT level, sta, COALESCE(allocated_stamina, 0) FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return get_starting_max_hp()
    level = int(row[0] or 1)
    base_sta = int(row[1] or 10) + int(row[2] or 0)
    item_sta = int(get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, "bonus_sta") or 0)
    rune_sta = int(get_worker_equipped_rune_sta_bonus_v2(conn, user_id) or 0)
    total_sta = base_sta + item_sta + rune_sta
    base_hp = calculate_base_max_hp(level, total_sta)
    bonus_percent = get_worker_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_v1(conn, user_id)
    dynamic_max_hp = max(1, int(round(base_hp * (1 + bonus_percent / 100.0))))
    try:
        user_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "users")
        if "max_hp" in user_cols:
            current_row = conn.execute("SELECT hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
            current_hp = int(current_row[0] or 0) if current_row else 0
            clamped_hp = min(current_hp, dynamic_max_hp)
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                (clamped_hp, dynamic_max_hp, user_id),
            )
            conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return dynamic_max_hp

def get_worker_equipped_int_wis_totals_18_15_8c(conn, user_id, base_intelligence, base_wisdom):
    """Reconstruct active item+rune INT/WIS exactly once for the worker."""
    intelligence = int(base_intelligence or 0)
    wisdom = int(base_wisdom or 0)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(it.bonus_int, 0)), 0),
                COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(it.bonus_wis, 0)), 0)
            FROM equipment_slots es
            JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id
            JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id
            WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
              AND COALESCE(inv.durability, 100) > 0
            """,
            (int(user_id),),
        ).fetchone()
        if row:
            intelligence += int(row[0] or 0)
            wisdom += int(row[1] or 0)
    except Exception:
        pass
    rune = get_worker_equipped_rune_int_wis_bonus_17_15_1_1(conn, user_id)
    intelligence += int(rune.get("int", 0) or 0)
    wisdom += int(rune.get("wis", 0) or 0)
    return intelligence, wisdom

def init_player_interaction_foundation(db_path=None):

    # Stage 14.1.0 PvP persistent foundation
    from systems.pvp_system import init_pvp_foundation, recover_pvp_after_restart
    init_pvp_foundation()
    recover_pvp_after_restart()
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        columns = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)")}
        if not columns:
            raise RuntimeError("users table is missing; init_db() must run first")
        added = False
        if "last_activity_at" not in columns:
            conn.execute("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_activity_at TEXT NULL")
            added = True
        conn.executescript("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_activity_sessions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                activity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
                    activity_type IN ('trade_request','trade','duel_request','pvp_battle')
                ),
                reference_id INTEGER NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            );
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_last_activity_at
                ON users(last_activity_at);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_activity_sessions_expires_at
                ON player_activity_sessions(expires_at);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_activity_sessions_type_status
                ON player_activity_sessions(activity_type, status);
        """)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    removed = expire_stale_player_activity_sessions(db_path=db_path)
    return {
        "success": True,
        "presence_column_added": added,
        "expired_sessions_removed": removed,
        "online_timeout_seconds": PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        "write_throttle_seconds": PLAYER_PRESENCE_WRITE_THROTTLE_SECONDS,
    }
